Title: Dataanalytiker til Brugeraktivering
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Brugeraktivering (Markedsføring og Brugerkontakt) bruger DR's egne kontaktpunkter — email, push, in-app og bannere — og førstepartsdata til at skabe relevant, public service-orienteret kontakt med brugerne på tværs af DRTV, DR Lyd og dr.dk. Kontaktpunkterne spiller forskellige roller gennem hele brugerrejsen — fra positionering og interesse til opdagelse, brug og genaktivering. Vi styrer efter både at nå bredt og at skabe dokumenterbar effekt, og vi søger en dataanalytiker, der kan give teamet det data- og indsigtsfundament, det kræver.

Ansvar og arbejdsopgaver

Analyse, dækning og effekt


Kvantitative analyser af brugeradfærd, kanalperformance og kampagneeffekt på tværs af DRTV, DR Lyd og dr.dk
Måling af dækning: unik rækkevidde, frekvens og dækning i prioriterede målgrupper — så vi ved, om vi når de rigtige brugere
Effektmåling og inkrementalitet: design og drift af lift-måling gennem holdout- og kontrolgrupper for aktiverende indsatser — så vi kan svare på, hvad vi faktisk flytter, ikke bare hvad vi nåede ud til
Være med til i samarbejde med Analyse at udvikle måling, der passer til indsatsens formål — også for positionerende og relationelle indsatser, hvor effekten ikke er en klik-konvertering
Mønstre i login, retention, frekvens og segmentrespons — og udlede, hvornår og hvordan brugere med størst sandsynlighed kan aktiveres
Omsætte adfærd til hypoteser, teste dem og levere konklusioner i et format, der kan handles på


Det tekniske fundament — data der bare virker


Bygge og vedligeholde dashboards, der gør teamet datadrevet (email, push, in-app, bannere, flows)
Sikre korrekte, stabile og veldefinerede events og datafelter — og forstå datastrømmene fra CDP og CEP
Udtrække og formatere data til segmentering, personalisering og effektmåling


Samarbejde på tværs


Du bliver en del af Brugeraktivering, men understøtter også Medieplanlægning med data — konkret vedligehold af effektmodellen og kampagne-/dækningsdashboards, så beslutninger om investering og kampagneeffekt hviler på et stabilt grundlag


Om rollen

Datamodenheden i vores felt er under opbygning — så en stor del af det første år handler om at bygge fundamentet: korrekte events, klar struktur på login/retention/frekvens, operationelle dashboards og bedre måling af både dækning og effekt. Det er præcis her, du får indflydelse. På sigt er ambitionen at bevæge sig mod mere avanceret modellering, efterhånden som datagrundlaget modnes.

Du bliver en del af et team på tværs af CRM, indhold, kampagner og analyse, og du refererer til teamlederen for Brugeraktivering.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du har en uddannelse inden for fx statistik, data science, økonomi eller lignende — eller tilsvarende erfaring — og at du er særligt stærk inden for:


Analyse af brugeradfærd, flows og segmentperformance
SQL og dashboarding (fx Mixpanel, MoEngage, Power BI eller Tableau)
Databehandling, datamodellering og datakvalitet
At formidle komplekse indsigter præcist og forståeligt — så de bliver brugt


Det er en fordel, hvis du desuden har:


Erfaring med et CDP/CEP-setup (vi arbejder i Segment og MoEngage) og et data warehouse (fx BigQuery)
Lettere Python til datarens, API-kald og automatisering
Forståelse for brugerrejser i streaming og audio/on-demand


Som person er du grundig og nysgerrig. Du kan tage et bredt mål og gøre det målbart, og du siger det tydeligt, når tallene ikke kan bære en konklusion. Du trives med at bygge noget op, hvor ikke alt er på plads fra start, og du ved, hvornår en analyse er god nok til at blive brugt.

Vi tilbyder


En rolle hvor du er med til at sætte standarden for, hvordan DR måler effekten af kommunikationen til brugerne
Et stort førstepartsdatagrundlag på tværs af DRTV, DR Lyd og dr.dk og et moderne setup med BigQuery, Segment, MoEngage og Mixpanel
Kort vej fra analyse til handling: dine tal indgår direkte i teamets prioritering
Faglig udvikling mod mere avanceret modellering, efterhånden som datagrundlaget modnes
Arbejde der handler om, at flere danskere får glæde af DR's indhold
Fuldtidsstilling (37 timer/uge) med tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst (AC)


Kontakt

DR ønsker at afspejle samfundet. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, religion, handicap og etnisk baggrund til at søge.

Du kommer til at arbejde i DR Byen, som har metro lige til døren.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte teamleder for Brugeraktivering Søren Ole Andersen, srand@dr.dk, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, dit cv og relevante eksamenspapirer.

Stillinger i DR søges udelukkende elektronisk.

Du søger ved at klikke på "Søg stillingen" i højre side.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 14. oktober 2026 kl. 12.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 43-44.

As AI & PowerBI Developer, you will bring AI and PowerBI into the daily work of the business. Working hands-on with data and close to the people who use your work, you will introduce new AI technologies, help colleagues make informed, data-driven decisions and gain broad exposure to Novo Nordisk’s product portfolio.

Title: Data Analyst / Biostatistician – Danish Blood Donor Study (DBDS) Department of Clinical Immunology, Aarhus University Hospital
Description:
Data Analyst / Biostatistician – Danish Blood Donor Study (DBDS) Department of Clinical Immunology, Aarhus University Hospital,

We are seeking a data analyst with strong statistical and data analytical skills to join the Danish Blood Donor Study (DBDS). The ideal candidate enjoys working with large, complex datasets and is also interested in the biological and clinical questions behind the data.

What We Offer

DBDS is a national research project built on one of the world's largest biobanks, with more than 180,000 participants and over 3 million plasma samples. The study combines laboratory and registry data with phenotype data collected through, for example, questionnaires. Our research covers a wide range of topics, including how genetic factors and plasma biomarkers can predict disease. DBDS is a unique cohort because of its granular longitudinal data and blood samples, which allow us to study biomarker change over time.

The position offers an exceptional opportunity to work with large, complex datasets in a research environment where data analysis is closely integrated with clinical and biological research. You will be part of an interdisciplinary team and apply your analytical skills to research with the potential to improve public health.

The Department of Clinical Immunology (Blodbank og Immunologi) at Aarhus University Hospital is Central Denmark Region's specialist department for clinical immunology. The department has approximately 220 employees and is responsible for producing blood components; laboratory testing, diagnostic investigations and advisory services in transfusion medicine and transplant immunology; HIV and hepatitis testing; autoimmune diagnostics; and the investigation of immunodeficiencies.

Job Description

As a data analyst in DBDS, you will analyse large, complex longitudinal datasets based on registry, questionnaire and biomarker data. You will contribute to research projects across DBDS and help translate research questions into robust analyses and meaningful results.

You will plan and conduct statistical analyses and select methods suited to each research question. You will collaborate closely with researchers, data managers and statisticians within the department and across the national DBDS network, where you will advise researchers on statistical methods and help them plan and interpret their analyses.

You will also contribute to the day-to-day operation of DBDS, including occasional data management and data quality tasks as needed.

Your profile

Ideally, you have a background in statistics, biostatistics, bioinformatics, mathematics, data science or a related field. You have strong skills in advanced data analysis, in developing and applying AI and machine learning methods, or both. What matters most is a solid understanding of statistical principles and the ability to select, apply and critically assess the methods best suited to each research question and dataset. A PhD or equivalent experience is preferred.

It is important to us that you


have experience handling and analysing large longitudinal datasets
have strong skills in R, Python or similar for data analysis and processing
have a solid understanding of statistical methods and can select appropriate models for each research question
have experience with, or an interest in, registry data and/or biomarker data
can plan and carry out analyses independently
can interpret data and communicate results clearly and precisely
understand, or are keen to learn about, the biological and clinical questions behind the analyses
work in a structured way and can manage several tasks at once
collaborate effectively and thrive in interdisciplinary settings
have strong communication skills in English.


Experience with epidemiological or population-based studies, or with biobank data, is an advantage.

Employment details

The position is based at the Department of Clinical Immunology, Aarhus University Hospital, in the research group led by Clinical Chair Professor and Chief Physician Christian Erikstrup.

This is a three-year fixed-term position with the possibility of extension. The position is intended to be full-time. The start date is January 1st 2027 or by agreement.

Salary and terms of employment

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement in Central Denmark Region. Employment is conditional upon a satisfactory child-related record check.

Application and contact

Applications may be written in Danish or English and must be received no later than November 8th 2026.

Interviews are expected to be held shortly thereafter. For further information about the position, please contact Clinical Chair Professor and Chief Physician Christian Erikstrup per mail christian.erikstrup@skejby.rm.dk.

The postion is primarly a full-time position.

Employees undergoing redeployment who apply for the position have priority in accordance with the applicable rules.

Under the EU Pay Transparency Directive, which took effect on June 7th 2026, Central Denmark Region is required to inform you of the starting salary, or the starting salary range, for a position before you are offered employment.

Central Denmark Region's salary catalogue for most staff groups and positions in the region is available here (in Danish): Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse – Medarbejder.rm.dk

Working with both financial and non-financial performance data, you will help support decision-making across Urban Partners while contributing to the continued development and optimisation of reporting processes.

Support financial and non-financial reporting across investments and funds.
Contribute to data quality, governance, and reporting consistency.
Assist in developing and maintaining reporting data models, cubes, and analytical tools that support scalable reporting and decision-making.
Support reporting optimisation, automation initiatives, and AI-enabled reporting processes to improve efficiency and reporting quality.
Act as a trusted business partner to Investor Relations, Finance, Sustainability, and Investment teams, helping translate business needs into data-driven reporting and decision support.


Your Experience & Skills

We are looking for a colleague with approximately 2-3 years of professional experience who enjoys working close to the numbers and understands the value of reliable data and high-quality reporting.


Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience from a hands-on finance-related role such as Financial Controller, Finance Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Accountant, Finance Business Partner, or similar
Strong Excel skills and experience working directly with reporting, reconciliations, analyses, and large datasets
Experience supporting reporting cycles, month-end activities, management reporting, or financial analysis
Interest in technology, automation, AI, and process optimisation
Excellent English skills
Digital skills and tool proficiency (e.g. SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, data structures, and data cubes)


It would be an advantage to have experience from investment management, real estate, asset management, private equity, fund structures or similar fields.

Your Character

As a person, you are motivated by learning, curious by nature, and enjoy taking ownership of your work.

You Are


Comfortable rolling up your sleeves and working directly with data, details, and reporting material.
Detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work
Analytical and structured, with a strong attention to accuracy
Curious and eager to continuously learn and develop
Collaborative and relationship-oriented, with a positive mindset
Motivated by contributing both professionally and socially to the team


What We Offer


Make a difference by helping create urban spaces and places that enrich people’s lives in the most sustainable way.
Lead the industry with an innovator that is pioneering new approaches while raising standards and inspiring the industry.
Learn and grow as part of a powerhouse of brilliant people where teamwork, feedback, and different ways of thinking are at the core.
Be your whole self in a purpose-driven culture with a strong sense of belonging, based on trust, celebration, and caring for each other.


In addition, you will gain broad exposure across multiple funds, countries, and business areas, giving you a unique opportunity to build both your finance expertise and your understanding of how reporting supports investment decision-making at scale.

Urban Partners is a visionary urban investment platform. Through our investment strategies, we combine financial performance with long-term value creation and responsible urban development.

BI Business Partner

Turn data into insights – and insights into better decisions.




The Role

We are looking for a BI Business Partner to join our BI team, which is part of our Commercial team. You are passionate about numbers, systems, and turning data into actionable insights that support the business.

You will work at the intersection of systems, data, and business, translating business needs into solutions in our BI tools and developing a strong understanding of how data can support and improve decision-making across the organization.

You will develop and support BI solutions that enable the Commercial team and the wider organization to make better and faster decisions.




About Link Logistics

Link Logistics was founded in 2002 with a clear promise: to make logistics digital, simple, and responsible. Today, we are an international and independent logistics company and a market-leading one-stop shop for express and parcel services, complemented by freight forwarding solutions across ocean, air, rail, and road.

We continue to grow both organically and through acquisitions and today have offices in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and the US, with more than 300 employees.

Our goal is to be the preferred logistics partner by delivering flexible services and integrated solutions, supported by innovative technology. Our success is driven by high-quality personal service and dedicated employees who are solution-oriented, take responsibility, and always look for a way forward.

We care deeply about our customers and our employees, and we are committed to creating a positive and friendly work environment where people can grow, take initiative, and make a difference.




Your key responsibilities:

Turn numbers and data into insights that support business decisions – from reporting to action
Bridge the gap between systems and business by translating complex business needs into practical BI solutions using Power BI and Microsoft Fabric
Ensure data accuracy and consistency across data, systems, and business operations
Contribute to the continued development of our BI setup as we further mature our Microsoft Fabric platform




We Imagine That You

Have an analytical mindset and a structured approach to working with large datasets
Are highly skilled in Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data modelling
Have experience with, or a strong interest in, Power BI and Microsoft Fabric
Have experience with SQL and are comfortable extracting and processing data directly from databases
Have a background in controlling, finance, business intelligence, or a similar field, preferably with a few years of relevant experience
Are motivated to develop your skills at the intersection of technology and business and become even stronger at translating between the two
Are a strong communicator and able to build relationships across the organization
Enjoy a varied range of tasks and take ownership of your responsibilities




What We Offer

A role close to the business, with the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and influence as you grow into the position
A dynamic working environment with strong opportunities for professional development
Supportive colleagues and a culture where you are encouraged to develop and reach your potential
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience
Pension and health insurance

We value diversity and inclusion. All qualified candidates, regardless of background, gender, or ethnicity, are encouraged to apply. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our organization and drive innovation.

Title: Commercial Analyst
Description:
Do you enjoy turning commercial data into decisions people trust, and do you look at a recurring manual task and ask "why am I still doing this by hand?" Then you might be our new Commercial Analyst.




At Continia, we believe nobody in commercial leadership should have to guess how the business is performing. We are looking for someone who can build the dashboards, models, and business cases that make that possible. The role is a central part of our Commercial Excellence team, where you will help our sales organization and partner network perform at their best.




Why now?

Over the past years, Continia has experienced substantial growth in both revenue and organizational scale, and our commercial decisions have become more complex along the way. Commercial Excellence is a young team built to meet that complexity with stronger systems, structure, and strategy. We have reached the point where we need someone to own the analytical layer that turns our commercial data into decisions. That is why we need you.




About the role

Commercial Excellence sits at the center of Continia's commercial engine. We own the systems, structure, and strategy that help our sales organization and partner network perform at their best. This role is focused on the analytical layer: the dashboards, models, and business cases that turn commercial data into decisions.




You will work closely with Sales, Finance, and Data Science, and sit close to commercial leadership. Your job is not just to report the numbers. It is to explain what they mean and what to do about them. We want someone who treats AI and automation as a default part of the toolkit.




You will know you are succeeding when every pricing decision, forecast, and business case is backed by numbers people trust, and when the reporting, the models, and the routine analysis that used to take a day now run themselves, because you built and automated the system behind them.




Your primary responsibilities

Translate commercial data into insights and recommendations that Sales, Finance, and leadership can act on
Develop and maintain dashboards and management reporting that give the business a clear, trusted view of commercial performance
Build and evaluate business cases, sizing opportunities, stress-testing assumptions, and making the numbers defensible
Perform pricing, profitability, and scenario analyses to support commercial decision-making
Support sales budgeting and forecasting in close collaboration with Finance
Monitor commercial KPIs and explain not just what happened, but why, and what it means going forward
Automate the recurring, manual parts of the job, such as data pulls, report refreshes, and first-pass analysis, using AI tools and scripting




Who are you?

You are curious, structured, and self-driven. You are confident translating messy commercial data into a clear recommendation, not just a chart, and you can speak the language of Sales, Finance, Data Science, and leadership alike. This role comes with a lot of ownership and not a lot of hand-holding.




You imagine you:

Have 5+ years in commercial analytics, business analysis, FP&A, or a similar role, ideally in a B2B software or SaaS environment
Have strong analytical and financial modelling skills and can build business cases and pricing or profitability analyses from scratch
Have owned dashboards or management reporting, including choosing what to measure and how to present it
Have hands-on experience with Power BI and AI tools (e.g. Copilot, ChatGPT/Claude, Python, or low-code automation), and have already changed how you work because of AI
Work comfortably with Sales, Finance, Data Science, and leadership as your primary stakeholders
Are fluent in English; Danish is a plus




What do we offer?

At Continia, you will become part of an international SaaS company with strong ambitions and a unique partner-driven go-to-market model.

You will get:

A seat at the table in a young function with real influence on how Continia makes commercial decisions
Close collaboration with senior commercial leadership and a direct line to strategy
A small, focused team where your work is visible and your impact is felt
The freedom to automate and rethink how analytical work gets done
A modern, collaborative working environment based in Aalborg




How to apply

If you think you'd be a great fit for this position, please upload your CV, including a few lines about why you're interested in this job.




Continia commits to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants with a Danish residence and work permit.




Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.




About Continia

Continia provides software for accounts payable automation, expense management, and bank integration to more than 20,000 customers worldwide.




We are proud of our strong company culture, where diversity and authenticity are valued. We believe in teamwork, open dialogue, and personal responsibility. Our focus on both personal and professional growth enables our employees to thrive and develop within the organization.

At Continia, we keep things simple, pragmatic, and results driven. We celebrate successes, big and small, and come together at annual company-wide events.




Above all, we value time. Continia solutions give customers more time every day, to work, to live, to grow. That's why our motto is "It's About Time".

Title: Associate Specialist, Purchase Research & Intelligence
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Drive meaningful change

Are you motivated by turning data into insights that influence business decisions? Join our Purchase Research & Intelligence team and help strengthen the analytical foundation behind one of our core commercial functions. In this role, you'll combine data, analytics, and business understanding to support decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the continued development of a growing and data-driven Purchase organization.

Get a glimpse of our world

Purchase Research & Intelligence (PRI) is the data and reporting function within our Purchase organization. As a recently established team within Commercial Development & Enablement, PRI supports Purchase with reporting, analytics, and commercial insights that enable informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

As part of the commercial organization, Purchase is the team's primary stakeholder and internal customer. This means the role combines analytical work with a strong understanding of the business context behind the data. Working closely with colleagues across Purchase, as well as the Digital department and the Digital Trading Products team, you'll contribute to strengthening the organization's analytical capabilities and support the continued development of data-driven ways of working

Are you ready to embark on this journey with us?

As our Associate Specialist, you'll help strengthen the analytical capabilities of the Purchase organization through reporting, analytics, and data-driven insights.

Your Main Responsibilities Include


Supporting the ongoing development, adoption, and business ownership of reporting solutions used across the Purchase organization.
Turning commercial questions and business needs into structured analytical outputs and actionable insights.
Preparing analyses and calculations that support sourcing decisions, commercial cases, and business priorities.
Working with purchasing and commercial data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Supporting the Purchase organization with data, reporting, and analytical insights as needed.
Contributing to the development and testing of AI-assisted tools and other data-driven solutions.
Identifying opportunities to improve reporting, analytical processes, and Purchase workflows.
Acting as a key link between Purchase and the Digital organization to ensure business needs are translated into valuable data-driven solutions.


Fuel for your success in the role

You are curious about how data can be used to support business decisions and motivated by turning information into actionable insights. With a structured and analytical approach, you enjoy working with data, solving problems, and collaborating with stakeholders to create value. You are eager to develop your technical capabilities while building a strong understanding of the commercial context behind the data.

Furthermore, We Imagine That You Bring


A Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related discipline combining commercial understanding with strong analytical capabilities.
0-2 years of experience working with data, analytics, reporting, or related disciplines.
Experience working with SQL skills and an interest in analyzing and working with data.
The interest in and ability to understand data, business processes, and the connections between them.
Experience working with business intelligence and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
Strong Excel skills and an interest in developing advanced analytical capabilities.
Experience with Python or similar tools for analysis, automation, or data preparation is an advantage.
An understanding of digital solutions, platforms, automation, and how technology can support business processes.
Curiosity towards new technologies, including AI-assisted tools and their practical application in a business environment.
A structured and analytical approach combined with a proactive and collaborative mindset.

Title: Category Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

About The Role

As a Category Analyst you will play a crucial role helping Haleon to analyse market trends, consumer behaviour, and sales data to provide actionable insights that drive our business strategies. This is a temporary role for 12 months.

You will closely collaborate with various teams across Nordics as well as senior leadership to better understand our current brand performances at retail level and to turn these findings into opportunities. Further you will lead the development, harmonization & utilization of sell out performance reporting across the Nordic markets.

We are seeking for a data-expert who is not only able to handle and simplify complex data but also passioned about generating insights and has the seniority to shape and influence commercial decision of various sales & marketing departments.

The role is part of our Nordic Category Management team and reports into the Category Management Lead Nordics. The role has Nordic a focus to drive the harmonization and utilization of our sell out data and a Swedish focus to support teams with ad-hoc analysis and insights that enables us to further drive the growth of our brands and categories within retail.

Key Responsibilities:


Develop & maintain Nordic dashboards to track key consumption performance indicators; monitor, report and advice on sales performance and market shares.
Conduct competitive analysis to understand market dynamics and identify potential threats and opportunities for the categories we are playing in.
Ensure a consistent performance tracking of new product launches and support teams by finding the right insights and datapoints to strengthen retail stories for new launches and listings.
Leverage existing data and reporting solutions of the wider BU analytic teams and be the central point of contact for data harmonization, exchange and improvements.
Collaborate with marketing, sales and commercial excellence teams to enhance utilization and understanding of sales data throughout the organization.
Drive marketing effectiveness analysis, especially within our D-Com channel.



Qualifications and Skills: Essential:


Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Econometrics or related.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to run ad hoc deep dives, to interpret complex data and to provide actionable insights via excellent presentation skills.
Profound experience in creation of automated regular performance reporting in Excel and preferably PowerBI; Expert knowledge of syndicated EPOS data
Excellent interpersonal & communication skills with strong customer focus and the capability to influence at different levels in the organization and at retail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities with a commitment to delivering on-time and quality results.
Proactive attitude and constant drive for change and improvement.
Fluent in English.



Preferred:


3+ years experience working in FMCG (client or agency side) in analytics roles.
Experience with Grocery, Pharmacy and D-Com retailer
Demonstrated project management skills leading cross-functional teams



Job Posting End Date

2026-10-07

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

Title: Commercial Business Analyst, Commercial Operations & Excellence, Lystrup or Søborg
Place: Søborg, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Do you want to turn commercial data into trusted insights that help drive better business decisions across a global organization? In this role, you will shape how pipeline, forecasting and commercial systems are used while helping colleagues unlock greater value from data, tools and AI-driven analysis. Come and join us!

We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes. We continue to evolve our advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry to deliver real-world solutions that matter to the security of people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for a Commercial Business Analyst to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.

Your role as part of the team

As our new Commercial Business Analyst, you will operate at the intersection of business, data and technology. You will transform commercial data into actionable insights while supporting and developing the systems, dashboards and processes that help our sales and marketing teams succeed. A key part of the role is building and maintaining trusted pipeline and forecasting dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.

In our team we take pride in developing people and technology. You will become part of the Commercial Operations & Excellence team, a newly established and growing team, with further expansion underway. We value collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, and we prioritize both professional development and social activities. You will work closely with Business Areas, Global Sales, Commercial Development, IT and other stakeholders across the organization. We care about the work we do and the people behind it.

Technical expertise is important, but your mindset matters just as much. If you are business-minded, curious, proactive and enjoy building relationships while turning complex data into meaningful insights, you could be a great addition to our team.

How you will make a meaningful contribution

In this role, you will contribute to a range of tasks across your area of responsibility. Your key responsibilities include:


Design, build and maintain pipeline and forecasting dashboards that provide a trusted and consistent view of commercial performance across Business Areas and regions
Deliver commercial analyses and insights related to pipeline development, forecasting, sales performance, order intake and win/loss trends, translating findings into actionable recommendations
Own and continuously improve reporting, dashboard governance and KPI definitions while driving data quality, adoption and common ways of working across the organization
Support and develop CRM and commercial systems, including user support, configuration, testing, data governance and coordination with IT and external vendors
Train, coach and support users, promote best practices, and explore opportunities within automation and AI-assisted reporting while validating outputs against source data.




Bring your expertise into play

To thrive in this role, we imagine that you bring some of the following qualifications:


Bachelor's or Master's degree within business, economics, engineering, data/IT or a related field
3-5 years of experience within commercial analysis, sales operations, business analysis or a similar role, preferably in a B2B or project-driven environment
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics or Salesforce, including pipeline, opportunity and forecasting data
Strong analytical skills with experience building dashboards, working with KPI design, data modelling and advanced Excel
Experience using AI-assisted tools such as Claude for reporting and analysis, combined with the ability to validate results and communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Most importantly, we believe diverse experiences add value to our team and organization. Therefore, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the above requirements.

As we are an international organization, it is important that you are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level.

Let’s secure people through advanced technology

We believe that different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds make us stronger. We are committed to creating a more diverse and balanced workplace that reflects the talent and perspectives around us. By creating an inclusive environment with equal opportunities to contribute, grow, and succeed, we aim to broaden our talent pool and strengthen our teams for the future. We want everyone to feel welcome, valued, and confident in pursuing their ambitions at Terma.

When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience great people, challenging tasks, and the opportunity to make an impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and knowledge sharing, where learning is embedded in everyday work and supported by colleagues across all career stages.

Benefits

International Environment: Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world.
Flexible Working Hours: The option to work from home up to two days per week.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: Receive a 10% paid pension along with a beneficial health care and insurance package and paid internet connection at home. Enjoy discounts from various business partners.
Well-being Perks: Opportunity to enroll in our on-site massage-offer at our locations in Denmark.
Social and Professional Events: We have an active staff association that arranges a variety of social activities and events to bring all of our colleagues together.

Career Paths: Opportunities to grow your career in a direction that suits you, whether you prefer a specialist path or a leadership role.

We are all Terma - diverse in skills and equal in value. That is why we encourage all individuals to apply and are committed to ensuring that every employee has equal opportunities to succeed and feel respected and valued within our organization. To support an unbiased evaluation process, we kindly encourage applicants to omit personal details such as photos and age from their applications.

If you would like to take on the challenge of working in an innovative company, we look forward to receiving your application. A resume is required, while a cover letter is optional. To ensure that your application will reach us and is properly processed, we only accept applications via www.terma.com. Applications will be processed continuously.

Title: Product Data Insights Lead
Description:
Product Data Insights Lead




Ballerup, DK, 2750




At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.




We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Do you want to turn complex insights into software that makes a real difference to millions of citizens?

Do you have a background in data research and a sharp analytical mind? Can you turn customer research, usage data and competitive signals into evidence that helps product managers act on the right thing at the right time, whether that's a new product or an improvement to an existing one? Then this could be your next role at KMD.




About the role




As Product Data Insights Lead, you carve out the data that matters from the noise around it e.g. customer research, usage patterns, customer feedback, value-hypothesis tests, and competitive and market signals and turn it into clear reports and tools that Product Managers can act on.

At its core, the job is analytical: you build the data foundation that shows how people really use KMD's products, where they get stuck and what to build or improve next. You decide what counts as solid evidence and make sure it reaches the right people, in the right shape, at the right time.

This is a hands-on role in our product portfolio governance team, where you'll work closely with product, tech and commercial leaders to make things happen.




Your tasks




Provide evidence-based input to product decisions by combining customer research, usage analytics, churn drivers and value-hypothesis testing, for both new product opportunities and improvements to existing ones
Identify usability issues, friction points and bottlenecks in the user journey, and surface them to product management with enough clarity and timing to act on
Turn validated insights into practical input for the roadmap
Own the metrics for usage, adoption and churn • Bring AI and new ways of working with product data insights to sharpen our understanding of users and set the standard for how PMs use it
Build scalable dashboards and reports together with the data team What you bring • Strong SQL and data modelling skills (e.g. star schemas) to build clean, reusable datasets
Hands-on experience extracting, transforming and loading data into Power BI (Power Query, DAX)
Solid statistical skills and an eye for the usability problems hiding in the data, not just the numbers
Experience combining user insight (feedback, interviews) with usage data
Experience building AI agents or LLM workflows, good judgement on when to trust the output, and the drive to bring this into how product management works
3-4 years of experience working with Saas products will be an advantage




What we offer




A central role in helping KMD's product teams spot the right opportunities at the right time with real impact on how we understand and use data and insight across product
Close collaboration with product management and senior stakeholders across the organisation
Flexible working conditions and a healthy focus on work-life balance




Interested?




We interview candidates on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply.

Questions about the role? Reach out to Morten Sunesen, Head of Product Portfolio and Governance, at mfo@kmd.dk

Title: Datakonsulenter med skarpt brugerfokus
Description:
Vil du være med til at understøtte, at både Toldstyrelsens direktion og dine kolleger på grænsestregen kan træffe datadrevne beslutninger? Trives du i spændet mellem forretning og it-understøttelse, og kan du omsætte store datamængder til lettilgængelige dataprodukter, der giver indsigt? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Bidrag til effektiv databrug, og understøt effektiv toldkontrol

I Toldstyrelsens datateam understøtter vi hele styrelsen på dataområdet og arbejder for en stadig mere datadrevet styrelse. Det gør vi blandt andet ved at udvikle datarapporter, som bruges både strategisk og operationelt lige fra direktionsgangen og helt ud til grænsestregen.

Som datakonsulent vil dine opgaver omfatte at:


afdække brugernes rapporteringsbehov
udvikle opgørelser af måltal
udvikle rapporter i Power BI
undervise i brugen af datarapporter
gøre det let at være databruger i Toldstyrelsen.


Teamet løser derudover en bred vifte af opgaver, som du også får mulighed for at bidrage til. Det kan fx være test af data fra nye systemer, udvikling af styrelsens datamodenhed og datagovernance.

Datateamet er en del af kontoret Forretningsudvikling og består af en souschef og ti medarbejdere, som arbejder med data hele vejen fra udtræk ved kilden til implementering af en færdigudviklet rapport. I Forretningsudvikling får du også kolleger, der arbejder med it-udvikling, procesoptimering og porteføljestyring.

Struktureret og samarbejdsorienteret med fokus på brugeren

Din uddannelse er ikke afgørende, og du kan være nyuddannet eller have nogle års erfaring med lignende opgaver.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har arbejdet med SQL og Power BI og har erfaring med eller kendskab til at arbejde med begrebsmodeller og logiske datamodeller.

Det er vigtigt, at du har et stærkt end-to-end-fokus i udviklingen af dataprodukter. Det vil sige, at du både kan afdække og forstå behov, kan omsætte behovene til dataløsninger og kan implementere løsningerne hos brugerne. Du skal kunne dykke ned i kildedata og sammen med dine toldfaglige kolleger finde frem til de processer, hvor det giver værdi at indarbejde data.

Det er desuden vigtigt, at du har lyst til og flair for at forstå dine toldfaglige kollegers opgaver, så teamet bliver en attraktiv sparringspartner i udviklingen af en mere datadrevet Toldstyrelse.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:


arbejder struktureret
er drevet af at forstå, hvordan data kan hjælpe dine toldfaglige kolleger, og hvordan ledere kan sætte data i spil
hele tiden har den enkelte brugers dataoplevelse som pejlemærke
kan lide at samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper
går dedikeret og optimistisk til dine opgaver.


Vi understøtter en international samfundsopgave

Toldstyrelsen har ca. 800 medarbejdere fordelt over hele landet. Vi kommer med vidt forskellige baggrunde og fagligheder – men vi er alle drevet af at tage del i en vigtig opgave, og vi er stolte af de resultater, vi skaber. I staben arbejder vi hver dag ambitiøst på at understøtte styrelsens kerneopgaver, og vi samarbejder på tværs af hele organisationen om konstruktive løsninger. Hvis du har lyst til at samarbejde med engagerede kolleger i hele landet og vil være med til at løse en international opgave, der skaber værdi for Danmark og sikrer det danske samfund, så er Toldstyrelsen noget for dig. Sammen skaber vi muligheder på tværs af grænser. Som en del af din onboarding vil du deltage i både e-læring og sidemandsoplæring og evt. anden intern undervisning.

I Forretningsudvikling værdsætter vi stor selvstændighed i arbejdet, fleksibilitet og gode udviklingsmuligheder. Vi hjælper hinanden og har en uhøjtidelig og humoristisk omgangstone kombineret med en dyb respekt for vores faglighed og opgaver.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send ansøgning, CV, eksamensbevis og evt. andre relevante dokumenter via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest onsdag den 28. oktober 2026.

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte souschef Michael Philip Poulsen på telefon 72 37 72 46.

Vi forventer at holde første samtalerunde i uge 45 og anden samtalerunde mandag den 16. november, her vil der indgå en case og evt. en test.

F orud for ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest. Du skal være opmærksom på, at din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne sikkerhedsgodkendelse under din ansættelse i stillingen. Hvis du allerede er sikkerhedsgodkendt i en anden offentlig myndighed og bliver tilbudt stillingen, ønsker vi at overtage din sikkerhedsgodkendelse fra din nuværende arbejdsplads, hvis forudsætningerne for det er opfyldt.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Ansættelse vil være i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Arbejdsstedet er Lyseng Allé 1, 8270 Højbjerg. Tiltrædelse pr. 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Læs mere om ansættelse i Toldstyrelsen på toldst.dk/job

Om Toldstyrelsen

’Vi beskytter det danske samfund mod ulovlige varer og sikrer korrekt betaling af told’

Toldstyrelsens opgave er at gøre det nemt for borgere og virksomheder at betale deres told. Samtidig er det vores ansvar at beskytte det danske samfund mod indførsel af illegale varer. I de kommende år har vi desuden en vigtig opgave med at implementere EU’s toldreform, som udgør den største omstilling på toldområdet, siden EU-toldunionen blev dannet i 1968.

Vi løser fagligt krævende opgaver i komplekse processer. Derfor kræver vi stærk koordinering og høj faglighed både internt og i samarbejdet med andre aktører, nationalt såvel som internationalt.

Læs mere om Toldstyrelsen på www.toldst.dk .

Toldstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Title: Data & Analytics Engineer
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Do you want to help shape data-driven Finance solutions and contribute to our AI journey?

At Ramboll, we believe in creating sustainable change through the power of people, knowledge, and innovation. We are looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer to join our Global Data & Analytics department at our head office in Denmark and help us build modern data solutions that support Finance with reliable insights and better decision-making.

In this role, you will work with Microsoft Fabric to develop data solutions that enable reporting, analytics, and visualization for Finance. You will help transform business needs into scalable and user-friendly solutions and contribute to strengthening the way data is used across the organisation.

At the same time, we are on an exciting AI journey and want to increasingly include AI in our solutions where it creates real business value. This means you will be part of a team that is not only building strong data foundations but also looking ahead to how analytics and AI can work together to create smarter solutions for the future.

Your new role

As our new Data & Analytics Engineer, you will play an important role in designing and developing data solutions that support Finance processes and reporting needs. You will work closely with colleagues across functions to understand requirements, structure data, and create visualizations that make complex information easier to use and act on.

Your key responsibilities will include:



Building and supporting data solutions in Microsoft Fabric for Finance-related use cases
Working with data extraction, transformation, modelling, and structuring
Developing clear and effective dashboards, reports, and visualizations
Collaborating with Finance stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions
Helping ensure high data quality, consistency, and usability
Contributing to the continuous development of our data and analytics capabilities
Exploring how AI can be included in solutions and workflows to create greater value



About You

You have a strong interest in data, analytics, and technology, and you are motivated by creating solutions that make a real difference for the business. You are curious, structured, and eager to learn, and you enjoy working in the space between business needs and technical possibilities.

We imagine that you have:



A relevant degree in data, IT, business analytics, finance, engineering, artificial intelligence or a related field
Solid knowledge of working with data and analytics
Experience with, or a strong interest in, data visualization
An interest in modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric
Curiosity about AI and how it can strengthen analytics solutions
A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving
Good communication and collaboration skills



It is an advantage if you also have:



Knowledge of Finance processes, reporting, or controlling
Experience with Power BI, SQL, or other Microsoft data tools
An understanding of how to translate business requirements into practical data solutions



What We Can Offer You

At Ramboll, you will join a collaborative and knowledge-driven environment where you can develop your skills while contributing to meaningful work. You will have the opportunity to work with modern technologies, engage with stakeholders across the business, and help shape solutions that support important Finance processes.

We offer:



A role in a professional and supportive Data & Analytics team
The opportunity to work with modern data technologies, including Microsoft Fabric
A chance to contribute to our AI journey and the future development of our solutions
Opportunities for learning, development, and career growth
A collaborative workplace at Ramboll’s head office in Denmark



Work at the heart of sustainable change

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. To do that, we need curious minds, diverse perspectives, and people who want to turn knowledge into action.

Interested?

If you are motivated by data, analytics, and the opportunity to help build valuable solutions for Finance, we would love to hear from you.

We welcome applications from candidates at different stages of their careers, including early-career professionals and recent graduates with a strong foundation in data and analytics.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Title: Financial Data Management Consultant, Datadriven Banking, Netcompany Banking Services
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description



Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping the financial sector turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.



Netcompany Banking Services 

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.



Responsibilities & technologies



You will become part of a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their businesses through data and insights, working at the intersection of technology and finance. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data. To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in financial data management.



Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.



Your responsibilites will typically include:



Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.



Structuring and collection of data from various sources.



Implementation of financial business logic on data for use in reporting.



Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.



Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.



About you



You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within finance and data management, probably from a bank, an asset manager or similar. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex financial data and challenges. You thrive in an environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.



To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:



ETL and Database technologies.



Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.



Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.



Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.



The financial sector, including regulatory reporting in the banking sector.



Join an inclusive community 



At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring. 



As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being. 



As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career. 



Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.



All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.



We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Title: BI Consultant
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in its Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the business. As part of this journey, we are modernizing how data is managed, governed, and leveraged across our global organization.

We are looking for a BI Consultant to join our Data & Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing expertise with a passion for partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful business value through data and analytics.

The role

As a BI Consultant, you will work closely with business stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to understand business challenges, define analytical requirements, and deliver reporting and analytics solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

You will play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of our enterprise data and reporting landscape while contributing to the continued development of our BI and analytics capabilities built on Microsoft Azure and Power BI.

This role requires a consultative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements and identify opportunities to create value through data and analytics
Designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI
Translating business requirements into scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions
Contributing to the development and evolution of our Enterprise Data Platform and Data Warehouse
Ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of enterprise data and reporting solutions
Supporting data governance, data quality, and master data management initiative
Driving adoption of self-service analytics and promoting best practices across the organization
Collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and other members of the Data & Analytics team


Suggested candidate profile

Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a relevant educational background within Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience delivering Business Intelligence and analytics solutions in a modern data environment.

You are someone who enjoys solving business challenges through data and turning complex requirements into meaningful insights. You are equally comfortable discussing business objectives with stakeholders and diving into the technical details of data models, reporting solutions, and analytics.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, and collaborative. You take ownership, build strong relationships across the organization, and maintain high standards for quality, professionalism, and data integrity.

More Specifically, You Bring


Around 5 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Warehousing, preferably from an international business environment
Strong experience with Power BI, including semantic modelling, DAX, and dashboard development
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with enterprise data warehouses
Experience gathering and translating business requirements into technical solutions
Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing principles
Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Data Lake) is considered an advantage
Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management principles is beneficial
Familiarity with Agile ways of working is a plus


Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

This role requires a consultative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

  • Partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements and identify opportunities to create value through data and analytics
  • Designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI
  • Translating business requirements into scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions
  • Contributing to the development and evolution of our Enterprise Data Platform and Data Warehouse
  • Ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of enterprise data and reporting solutions
  • Supporting data governance, data quality, and master data management initiative
  • Driving adoption of self-service analytics and promoting best practices across the organization
  • Collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and other members of the Data & Analytics team

Suggested candidate profile

Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a relevant educational background within Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience delivering Business Intelligence and analytics solutions in a modern data environment.

You are someone who enjoys solving business challenges through data and turning complex requirements into meaningful insights. You are equally comfortable discussing business objectives with stakeholders and diving into the technical details of data models, reporting solutions, and analytics.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, and collaborative. You take ownership, build strong relationships across the organization, and maintain high standards for quality, professionalism, and data integrity.

More Specifically, You Bring

  • Around 5 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Warehousing, preferably from an international business environment
  • Strong experience with Power BI, including semantic modelling, DAX, and dashboard development
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with enterprise data warehouses
  • Experience gathering and translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing principles
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Data Lake) is considered an advantage
  • Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management principles is beneficial
  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working is a plus

Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

Description:
Are you a curious & analytical thinker with a passion for both numbers and people? Would you like to be part of shaping and executing our Procurement Analytics transformation?

Join Ambu’s Global Procurement Transformation Journey

At our headquarters in Ballerup, you will become a part of our Procurement Insights team, a cross-functional unit within the Global Procurement department. Your day will involve collaborating with strategic procurement colleagues spanned out across the globe, from Malaysia to Mexico, China and the US as well as numerous stakeholders from different corners of the company.

In Procurement Insights, we enable and support our colleagues to deliver excellent procurement value. With data, analytics, and business intelligence we are evolving the way we do procurement.

Data & Analytics meets Procurement

We are currently investing in our people, processes and technology to enable value-driven procurement decisions. You will join a team of skilled & dedicated colleagues working to develop the data & analytics capability of the future for Global Procurement.

Your role will be key to ensuring that we take full advantage of the data & technology at our disposal, by bringing your curiosity, analytical skills and critical thinking into play.

You will be an important player in bringing this ambition to life

Executing various analytics projects, e.g., market-, commodity- & fundamental analysis, forecasting, cost-breakdown modelling & should-cost analysis, etc.
Providing procurement colleagues with various data, insights, and tool & application support for projects and activities at various stages (tendering, contract negotiations, etc.)
Developing new analytical concepts, modelling, and -systems to provide actionable insights into market and spend developments for our key stakeholders
Shaping and developing the future analytics agenda of Global Procurement to ensure we get the most out of our data and technology, as well as making sure that we stay on top of future analytics trends


Curious & Analytical thinker with a passion for numbers, people & technology

It is vital that you are curious about how things work and have a strong interest in data & analytics. We expect you to naturally seek new challenges, tasks, and technology. You possess strong communication and people skills, enabling you to build sound relationships and collaborate well across multiple functions.

We imagine our new Procurement Analyst having some years of relevant work experience. You likely have an M.Sc. in Business Intelligence, Data Science, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or similar.

Experiment and aren’t afraid of failing while trying new things

Title: Commercial Excellence Analyst I, Senior
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Commercial Excellence Analyst

PPG is a global coatings company with operations in over 70 countries and more than 180 years of industry leadership. As part of its Architectural Coatings EMEA division, PPG is executing a significant commercial transformation across all markets, and the Danish market is a key part of that journey.

This role is central to making that transformation happen on the ground while contributing to a regional agenda that reaches well beyond Denmark. For the right candidate, it offers a rare combination of local impact, regional visibility, and the opportunity to develop cross-functional expertise across commercial strategy, data analytics, and change leadership from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Excellence & Sales Transformation


Coordinate and drive the implementation of PPG's sales transformation framework across the Danish market, covering seven key streams: sales talent, sales training, sales leadership, Salesforce CRM pipeline management, operating cadence, customer relationship management, and sales enablement.
Act as the bridge between global strategy and local execution, ensuring that regional priorities are adapted and embedded effectively within the local organization.
Support the design and delivery of sales training initiatives to build capability across the local sales team.
Track, analyse, and report on key performance indicators, feeding insights into performance reviews and transformation progress discussions.
Collaborate closely with the Market Unit Director and the regional Commercial Excellence team to ensure alignment and consistency.


Pricing & Revenue Growth Analytics


Conduct pricing and profitability analyses to directly inform commercial strategy at both local and EMEA level.
Build and maintain dashboards and market insight tools that support data-driven decision making.
Monitor the effectiveness of pricing actions and ensure findings are communicated clearly to relevant stakeholders.


What We're Looking For


2-4 years of experience in a commercial, sales, business analytics, or related role.
Solid understanding of commercial and sales processes.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Excel.
Experience working with Salesforce CRM is an advantage.
Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools is a plus.
Fluency in both Danish and English.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
A proactive mindset and eagerness to work across functions in an international environment.


Why Join PPG?

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded analyst who wants to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will work closely with local leadership while gaining exposure to regional commercial excellence initiatives and best practices across EMEA.

How We Work

At PPG, we bring teams together to accelerate collaboration and career development, with in-person work Monday through Thursday and the opportunity to work remotely on Flexible Fridays. Schedules may vary by location.

Ready to make an impact? Join PPG and help shape the future of commercial excellence while building a rewarding international career.

Through leadership in innovation, sustainability and color, PPG helps customers in industrial, transportation, consumer products, and construction markets and aftermarkets to enhance more surfaces in more ways than does any other company. To learn more, visit www.ppg.com and follow @PPG on X.

We are customer champions

Proactive. Bold. Trustworthy. Everything we do starts with our customers. We listen, move fast and don’t stop until we solve their biggest challenges. When our customers win, we all grow.

Future-focused. Driven. Ambitious. We are passionate about growing our business and winning with our customers. We deliver results, embrace new technologies and leverage agility and speed as strengths.

Title: Skab forretningsindsigter der påvirker beslutninger
Description:
Er du den der i en central rolle kan analysere, håndtere og synliggøre tallene for forretningen, så vi får omsat indsigter til forretningsbeslutninger?

I Andel Energi søger vi en erfaren kommerciel Forretnings- og Markedsanalytiker, der vil være med til at sikre, at vi træffer de rigtige beslutninger i en forretning under konstant udvikling.

"Vi står midt i en spændende fusion, hvor tre selskaber samles omkring en fælles måde at forstå og styre forretningen på. Vores analyser spiller en vigtig rolle i at skabe indsigt og retning, for at prioritere de indsatser, der giver værdi for både kunder og forretning” fortæller afdelingsleder Adin Gradascevic.

Vi udvikler fremtidens energiselskab

Du får en central rolle i krydsfeltet mellem analyse, økonomi og kommerciel forretning, hvor du er med til at understøtte beslutningskraften i Andel Energi. Som en del af Performance & Data afdelingen omsætter og formidler du indsigt til anbefalinger, der skaber retning og resultater.

Sammen med forretningen, finance og ledelsen arbejder du med spørgsmål som: Hvordan udvikler vores salg og kundeportefølje sig, og hvad driver udviklingen? Hvorfor performer vi bedre eller dårligere end forventet? Og hvor skal vi sætte ind for at løfte de kommercielle resultater, så vi gør det endnu lettere for danskerne at vælge grøn energi og elektrificere hverdagen?

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:


Drive og formidle performance på tværs af forretningen
Analysere udviklingen i salg, kundeadfærd og kommercielle KPI'er
Identificere muligheder og risici samt anbefale konkrete initiativer
Udarbejde analyser og beslutningsoplæg, der understøtter ledelsens beslutninger
Facilitere performancemøder med ledere og nøgleinteressenter og sikre, at aftalte indsatser følges til dørs
Videreudvikle KPI-strukturer, rapportering og styringsmodeller


Du vil opleve, at dine analyser ikke ender i en rapport, men bruges målrettet til at prioritere investeringer, forbedre kundeoplevelsen og forbedre vores position på et energimarked i hastig udvikling. Vores målsætning er klar: Vi vil skabe Danmarks største og mest innovative energiselskab.

En hverdag med både kommercielle indsigter og relationer

Din hverdag vil både bestå af løbende performance- og budgetopfølgning, facilitering af performancemøder, udvikling af rapportering og tæt dialog med forretningen. Du skal kunne gå fra det detaljerede datagrundlag til det større kommercielle billede - og formidle dine indsigter, så de kan omsættes til handling.

Det er en rolle for dig, der ikke blot vil fortælle, hvad der er sket, men også vil være med til at forstå hvorfor det sker, hvad det betyder for forretningen, og hvor vi skal sætte ind.

Du bliver en del af et team på tolv kolleger, hvor faglig sparring, samarbejde og fælles mål går hånd i hånd med en uformel og hjælpsom kultur.

Hvem er du?

Du er en erfaren analytiker med solid forretningsforståelse og et kommercielt mindset. Du motiveres af at skabe forretningsværdi gennem indsigter og trives med at arbejde tæt på beslutningstagere. Som person er du nysgerrig, initiativrig og trives med at udfordre eksisterende antagelser på en konstruktiv måde. Du følger op, skaber fremdrift og bidrager til et godt samarbejde omkring dig.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:


Har en relevant videregående uddannelse, fx cand.merc., og erfaring fra en abonnementsforretning eller anden kommerciel forretning
Har solid erfaring med performance management, kommercielle analyser og evnen til at omsætte indsigter til konkrete anbefalinger og handling
Er en dygtig formidler, der kan gøre komplekse sammenhænge enkle og relevante og skabe dialog på tværs af forretningen
Formidler komplekse emner på en klar og engagerende måde. Skaber fremdrift og gode relationer i dialogen mellem forskellige dele af forretningen
Er fortrolig med Excel og PowerPoint og bruger dem til at skabe overblik og formidle dine indsigter effektivt


Et Andel Energi i bevægelse – vil du med?

Lyder det som noget for dig, så send din ansøgning og dit CV via linket i annoncen. For at sikre gældende GDPR-lovgivning modtager vi kun ansøgninger via jobannoncen. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Adin Gradascevic på telefon nummer 28344037.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Vi afholder samtaler i to omgange. Første samtale er med afdelingsleder og handler primært om opgaveløsning og faglige kompetencer. Går du videre til anden samtale, vil du inden få en case samt besvare to analyser: en logisk og en adfærdsanalyse. Disse er udgangspunkt for dialogen til samtalen.

Første samtaler afholdes uge 43. Anden samtaler med case og analyser afholdes d.27 oktober.

Vil du vide mere om rekrutteringsproces og kultur kan du læse mere på vores koncernhjemmeside: andel.dk/karriere.

Vi kombinerer formål, faglighed og fællesskab

Hos Andel Energi kommer du til en arbejdsplads, der engagerer sig i at gøre det nemt for vores kunder at få en grønnere hverdag. Andel Energi er en del af det andelsejede Andel, og vi arbejder langsigtet og formålsdrevet for at skabe en grønnere fremtid. I vores organisation er der plads til nye idéer, forandringer og fællesskab – og vores kultur bygger på tillid og samarbejde.

Læs mere om Andel Energi på hjemmesiden: Andelenergi.dk.

#Andelenergi

Som kollega i Andel Energi er du en del af den grønne omstilling

I Andel Energi leverer vi el, naturgas og energirådgivning til mere end 1,2 mio. privat- og erhvervskunder. Som Danmarks største energiselskab har vi et stort ansvar for at sætte fart på den grønne omstilling.

Derfor arbejder vi for at skabe energiløsninger, som er gode for alle og gode for fremtiden. Det skal være let for alle at spare på energien og træffe grønne valg.

Andel Energi er en del af Andel, en andelsejet energi- og fibernetkoncern, der skaber velfærd og vækst i det danske samfund gennem leverance af vital infrastruktur og fremtidssikrede energiløsninger. Det gør vi, når vi investerer visionært i fibernet, vindmøller, energiløsninger og ladeinfrastruktur til elbiler. I Andel vil vi være hinandens bedste forbindelse. Vi har 2,8 millioner kundeforhold og 1.700 kolleger, der tager ansvar for at skabe en fælles fremtid – for vores kunder, andelshavere og vores omverden. Andel har hovedsæde i Svinninge og primære lokationer i Ballerup, Haslev og Virum.

I Andel Energi hylder vi fællesskabet og forskelligheden og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold at søge vores ledige stillinger.
