Title: Data & Analytics Engineer
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Do you want to help shape data-driven Finance solutions and contribute to our AI journey?

At Ramboll, we believe in creating sustainable change through the power of people, knowledge, and innovation. We are looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer to join our Global Data & Analytics department at our head office in Denmark and help us build modern data solutions that support Finance with reliable insights and better decision-making.

In this role, you will work with Microsoft Fabric to develop data solutions that enable reporting, analytics, and visualization for Finance. You will help transform business needs into scalable and user-friendly solutions and contribute to strengthening the way data is used across the organisation.

At the same time, we are on an exciting AI journey and want to increasingly include AI in our solutions where it creates real business value. This means you will be part of a team that is not only building strong data foundations but also looking ahead to how analytics and AI can work together to create smarter solutions for the future.

Your new role

As our new Data & Analytics Engineer, you will play an important role in designing and developing data solutions that support Finance processes and reporting needs. You will work closely with colleagues across functions to understand requirements, structure data, and create visualizations that make complex information easier to use and act on.

Your key responsibilities will include:



Building and supporting data solutions in Microsoft Fabric for Finance-related use cases
Working with data extraction, transformation, modelling, and structuring
Developing clear and effective dashboards, reports, and visualizations
Collaborating with Finance stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions
Helping ensure high data quality, consistency, and usability
Contributing to the continuous development of our data and analytics capabilities
Exploring how AI can be included in solutions and workflows to create greater value



About You

You have a strong interest in data, analytics, and technology, and you are motivated by creating solutions that make a real difference for the business. You are curious, structured, and eager to learn, and you enjoy working in the space between business needs and technical possibilities.

We imagine that you have:



A relevant degree in data, IT, business analytics, finance, engineering, artificial intelligence or a related field
Solid knowledge of working with data and analytics
Experience with, or a strong interest in, data visualization
An interest in modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric
Curiosity about AI and how it can strengthen analytics solutions
A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving
Good communication and collaboration skills



It is an advantage if you also have:



Knowledge of Finance processes, reporting, or controlling
Experience with Power BI, SQL, or other Microsoft data tools
An understanding of how to translate business requirements into practical data solutions



What We Can Offer You

At Ramboll, you will join a collaborative and knowledge-driven environment where you can develop your skills while contributing to meaningful work. You will have the opportunity to work with modern technologies, engage with stakeholders across the business, and help shape solutions that support important Finance processes.

We offer:



A role in a professional and supportive Data & Analytics team
The opportunity to work with modern data technologies, including Microsoft Fabric
A chance to contribute to our AI journey and the future development of our solutions
Opportunities for learning, development, and career growth
A collaborative workplace at Ramboll’s head office in Denmark



Work at the heart of sustainable change

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. To do that, we need curious minds, diverse perspectives, and people who want to turn knowledge into action.

Interested?

If you are motivated by data, analytics, and the opportunity to help build valuable solutions for Finance, we would love to hear from you.

We welcome applications from candidates at different stages of their careers, including early-career professionals and recent graduates with a strong foundation in data and analytics.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Title: Procurement Analyst
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you a curious & analytical thinker with a passion for both numbers and people? Would you like to be part of shaping and executing our Procurement Analytics transformation?

Join Ambu’s Global Procurement Transformation Journey

At our headquarters in Ballerup, you will become a part of our Procurement Insights team, a cross-functional unit within the Global Procurement department. Your day will involve collaborating with strategic procurement colleagues spanned out across the globe, from Malaysia to Mexico, China and the US as well as numerous stakeholders from different corners of the company.

In Procurement Insights, we enable and support our colleagues to deliver excellent procurement value. With data, analytics, and business intelligence we are evolving the way we do procurement.

Data & Analytics meets Procurement

We are currently investing in our people, processes and technology to enable value-driven procurement decisions. You will join a team of skilled & dedicated colleagues working to develop the data & analytics capability of the future for Global Procurement.

Your role will be key to ensuring that we take full advantage of the data & technology at our disposal, by bringing your curiosity, analytical skills and critical thinking into play.

You will be an important player in bringing this ambition to life

Skills

In this role you will be expected to use your skills to create real impact in a fast-growing, global organization. As our new Procurement Analyst, some of your main tasks will be:


Executing various analytics projects, e.g., market-, commodity- & fundamental analysis, forecasting, cost-breakdown modelling & should-cost analysis, etc.
Providing procurement colleagues with various data, insights, and tool & application support for projects and activities at various stages (tendering, contract negotiations, etc.)
Developing new analytical concepts, modelling, and -systems to provide actionable insights into market and spend developments for our key stakeholders
Shaping and developing the future analytics agenda of Global Procurement to ensure we get the most out of our data and technology, as well as making sure that we stay on top of future analytics trends


Curious & Analytical thinker with a passion for numbers, people & technology

It is vital that you are curious about how things work and have a strong interest in data & analytics. We expect you to naturally seek new challenges, tasks, and technology. You possess strong communication and people skills, enabling you to build sound relationships and collaborate well across multiple functions.

We imagine our new Procurement Analyst having some years of relevant work experience. You likely have an M.Sc. in Business Intelligence, Data Science, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or similar.


Have strong analytical skills and take a critical approach to the data and problems you work with
Find pragmatic solutions by applying methods and theory balanced with a good understanding of business needs
Experiment and aren’t afraid of failing while trying new things
Use your analytical mindset and a structured way of working, to competently translate high complexity into simple concepts, and communicate these clearly and concisely
Are fluent in English


Application deadline: 18th October 2026

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Commercial Excellence Analyst I, Senior
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Commercial Excellence Analyst

PPG is a global coatings company with operations in over 70 countries and more than 180 years of industry leadership. As part of its Architectural Coatings EMEA division, PPG is executing a significant commercial transformation across all markets, and the Danish market is a key part of that journey.

This role is central to making that transformation happen on the ground while contributing to a regional agenda that reaches well beyond Denmark. For the right candidate, it offers a rare combination of local impact, regional visibility, and the opportunity to develop cross-functional expertise across commercial strategy, data analytics, and change leadership from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Excellence & Sales Transformation


Coordinate and drive the implementation of PPG's sales transformation framework across the Danish market, covering seven key streams: sales talent, sales training, sales leadership, Salesforce CRM pipeline management, operating cadence, customer relationship management, and sales enablement.
Act as the bridge between global strategy and local execution, ensuring that regional priorities are adapted and embedded effectively within the local organization.
Support the design and delivery of sales training initiatives to build capability across the local sales team.
Track, analyse, and report on key performance indicators, feeding insights into performance reviews and transformation progress discussions.
Collaborate closely with the Market Unit Director and the regional Commercial Excellence team to ensure alignment and consistency.


Pricing & Revenue Growth Analytics


Conduct pricing and profitability analyses to directly inform commercial strategy at both local and EMEA level.
Build and maintain dashboards and market insight tools that support data-driven decision making.
Monitor the effectiveness of pricing actions and ensure findings are communicated clearly to relevant stakeholders.


What We're Looking For


2-4 years of experience in a commercial, sales, business analytics, or related role.
Solid understanding of commercial and sales processes.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Excel.
Experience working with Salesforce CRM is an advantage.
Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools is a plus.
Fluency in both Danish and English.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
A proactive mindset and eagerness to work across functions in an international environment.


Why Join PPG?

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded analyst who wants to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will work closely with local leadership while gaining exposure to regional commercial excellence initiatives and best practices across EMEA.

How We Work

At PPG, we bring teams together to accelerate collaboration and career development, with in-person work Monday through Thursday and the opportunity to work remotely on Flexible Fridays. Schedules may vary by location.

Ready to make an impact? Join PPG and help shape the future of commercial excellence while building a rewarding international career.

Title: BI Consultant
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in its Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the business. As part of this journey, we are modernizing how data is managed, governed, and leveraged across our global organization.

We are looking for a BI Consultant to join our Data & Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing expertise with a passion for partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful business value through data and analytics.

The role

As a BI Consultant, you will work closely with business stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to understand business challenges, define analytical requirements, and deliver reporting and analytics solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

You will play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of our enterprise data and reporting landscape while contributing to the continued development of our BI and analytics capabilities built on Microsoft Azure and Power BI.

This role requires a consultative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements and identify opportunities to create value through data and analytics
Designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI
Translating business requirements into scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions
Contributing to the development and evolution of our Enterprise Data Platform and Data Warehouse
Ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of enterprise data and reporting solutions
Supporting data governance, data quality, and master data management initiative
Driving adoption of self-service analytics and promoting best practices across the organization
Collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and other members of the Data & Analytics team


Suggested candidate profile

Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a relevant educational background within Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience delivering Business Intelligence and analytics solutions in a modern data environment.

You are someone who enjoys solving business challenges through data and turning complex requirements into meaningful insights. You are equally comfortable discussing business objectives with stakeholders and diving into the technical details of data models, reporting solutions, and analytics.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, and collaborative. You take ownership, build strong relationships across the organization, and maintain high standards for quality, professionalism, and data integrity.

More Specifically, You Bring


Around 5 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Warehousing, preferably from an international business environment
Strong experience with Power BI, including semantic modelling, DAX, and dashboard development
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with enterprise data warehouses
Experience gathering and translating business requirements into technical solutions
Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing principles
Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Data Lake) is considered an advantage
Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management principles is beneficial
Familiarity with Agile ways of working is a plus


Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Financial Data Management Consultant, Datadriven Banking, Netcompany Banking Services
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description



Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping the financial sector turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.



Netcompany Banking Services 

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.



Responsibilities & technologies



You will become part of a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their businesses through data and insights, working at the intersection of technology and finance. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data. To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in financial data management.



Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.



Your responsibilites will typically include:



Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.



Structuring and collection of data from various sources.



Implementation of financial business logic on data for use in reporting.



Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.



Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.



About you



You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within finance and data management, probably from a bank, an asset manager or similar. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex financial data and challenges. You thrive in an environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.



To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:



ETL and Database technologies.



Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.



Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.



Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.



The financial sector, including regulatory reporting in the banking sector.



Join an inclusive community 



At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring. 



As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being. 



As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career. 



Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.



All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.



We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Title: Byg fremtidens dataløsninger i Nykredit-koncernen
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med til at bygge næste generation af dataløsninger for Treasury- og risikoområdet? Og vil du sætte retning for Nykredit-koncernens dataagenda? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Data er afgørende for en moderne finansiel virksomhed. Nykredit-koncernen moderniserer sit datalandskab, og i Treasury & Risk Insights skal flere forretningskritiske løsninger flyttes til den nye dataplatform. Vi søger derfor en senior dataanalytiker, der vil forme næste generation af dataløsninger for Treasury- og risikoområdet. Du får reel indflydelse på både løsningerne, teknologien og vores måde at arbejde på.

Nykredit-koncernen er ejet af en forening af vores kunder, Forenet Kredit. Det betyder, at vi kan dele vores fremgang med vores kunder, når det går os godt, og at vi påtager os et særligt ansvar over for det samfund, vi er en del af. Det vil du også opleve, når vi kan byde dig velkommen som senior dataanalytiker.

En reel transformationsopgave

I Treasury & Risk Insights leverer vi data og løsninger til kapital-, likviditets- og risikostyring samt myndighedsrapportering. Det stiller høje krav til kvalitet, transparens og stabilitet.

Nu skal løsningerne moderniseres og flyttes til Nykredit-koncernens nye dataplatform. Vi skal ikke blot kopiere det eksisterende, men forstå, hvad der skaber værdi, forenkle og bygge til fremtidens behov.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver

Du skal styrke datafundamentet for Treasury- og risikoområdet i tæt samarbejde med udviklere, platformansvarlige, dataejere og forretningen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:


Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til robuste dataløsninger.
Udarbejde prototyper i SQL og moderne dataværktøjer.
Samarbejde med udviklere om at omsætte design til velfungerende produkter.
Drive migreringen til Nykredits nye dataplatform.
Indarbejde datakvalitet, dokumentation og governance i løsningerne.



Teknologi, der giver nye muligheder

Databricks bliver central sammen med Azure, SQL og moderne principper for datamodellering, integration og automatisering. AI er allerede en del af værktøjskassen og åbner nye muligheder for at analysere, udvikle og skalere løsninger. Du behøver ikke kende alle teknologierne fra første dag. Det vigtigste er en solid datafaglighed og lysten til at lære og omsætte nye muligheder til løsninger, der skaber værdi.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Din titel er mindre vigtig. Du kan være dataanalytiker, business analyst, data engineer, udvikler eller noget helt femte. Det afgørende er, at du kombinerer forretningsforståelse med interesse for data og teknologi.

Vi forestiller os, at du:


har erfaring med datamodellering og komplekse datastrukturer,
trives i feltet mellem forretning og teknologi,
ser muligheder i nye teknologier og arbejdsformer,
tager ansvar og følger opgaver til dørs,
arbejder både grundigt og pragmatisk.



Erfaring fra finanssektoren eller med regulatorisk rapportering er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder konkret erfaring med Databricks.

Dit nye team

Du bliver en del af et fagligt dygtigt og uformelt miljø med kolleger i København og Warszawa. Vi arbejder med forretningskritiske løsninger og tæt sammen på tværs af forretningen og IT.

Vi lægger vægt på ansvar, ærlig dialog og korte veje fra idé til handling. Du får stor frihed og reel mulighed for at påvirke både løsningerne og vores måde at arbejde på.

Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, funktionschef Jens Eskildsen på tlf. 21 56 91 97, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Title: Procurement Performance & Excellence Analyst
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Company Description

Heimstaden Group is a pan-European real estate investor, manager and operator. We manage approximately 155,500 homes across nine countries, representing a property value of around EUR 30 billion.

Our business is supported by close to 2,000 people across Czechia, Denmark, Finland, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Sweden and the United Kingdom.

We are looking for a Procurement Performance & Excellence Analyst to join our Group Procurement team and help build a more data-driven, high-performing and forward-looking procurement function.




Job Description

This is a build role rather than a traditional buyer role. You will strengthen how procurement is measured, steered and supported across the group by improving reporting, spend visibility, value tracking, governance and supplier-related data. The role combines analytics, process improvement and cross-functional business support in an environment where procurement is expected to contribute visibly to margin improvement and operational discipline.




Your mission

Your mission will be to build the performance management and data foundation of Group Procurement across markets. You will help turn procurement activity into clear management insight, stronger prioritization and more consistent value delivery.




What You Will Do

Own and develop procurement KPIs, dashboarding and recurring performance reporting.
Create spend analyses and improve spend visibility by category, supplier and market.
Support savings pipeline management and realised value tracking together with finance and controlling.
Generate analyses that help prioritise categories, projects and procurement opportunities.
Review, simplify and update procurement processes, templates, manuals and governance material.
Improve supplier-related data and contribute to sustainability reporting readiness in priority areas.
Support the evaluation and practical use of tools that strengthen procurement ways of working.
Work closely with Group Procurement, local procurement teams, business controlling, asset management and sustainability.




What Success Looks Like In Your First 12 Months

A monthly procurement performance pack is established and used as part of the management rhythm.
Spend data is easier to access, categorize and use for procurement prioritization.
Savings pipeline and value tracking are structured through a finance-aligned methodology.
Key procurement processes and governance documents have been simplified and refreshed.
Supplier-data readiness for sustainability reporting is stronger and less dependent on manual collection.




What we are looking for

2-3 years of relevant experience in procurement, procurement excellence, business analysis, business controlling, consulting or a related field.
A university degree in business, economics, supply chain or a comparable discipline.
Strong analytical skills and experience translating data into actions, insight and business cases.
Advanced Excel capability and experience with Power BI or a similar reporting tool.
Experience with KPI design, dashboards, reporting or performance management.
A good understanding of procurement, supplier-related analysis or adjacent business processes.
Experience improving processes, governance or ways of working in a business environment.
Fluent English, written and spoken.




Nice to have

Experience from the real estate sector or another asset-heavy industry.
Experience from management consulting or a procurement-focused environment.
Exposure to spend analytics, supplier sustainability, ESG or supplier-data reporting topics.
SQL or similar data-handling skills.
German and/or Scandinavian language skills.




Who You Are

You are proactive, structured and comfortable creating momentum in areas that still need more structure. You enjoy working independently, but you also like engaging with stakeholders across functions and levels. You do not only produce analysis - you make it useful, visible and actionable.

Additional Information




Why join us

You will shape a capability, not only maintain one.
You will have high visibility and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
You will work across procurement, finance, sustainability and local markets.
You will combine analysis, process improvement and implementation in one role.
You will join a large and ambitious European residential real estate organization with strong internal development opportunities.




Practical information

Full-time position.

Company Description

Heimstaden Group is a pan-European real estate investor, manager and operator. We manage approximately 155,500 homes across nine countries, representing a property value of around EUR 30 billion.

Our business is supported by close to 2,000 people across Czechia, Denmark, Finland, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Sweden and the United Kingdom.

We are looking for a Procurement Performance & Excellence Analyst to join our Group Procurement team and help build a more data-driven, high-performing and forward-looking procurement function.


Job Description

This is a build role rather than a traditional buyer role. You will strengthen how procurement is measured, steered and supported across the group by improving reporting, spend visibility, value tracking, governance and supplier-related data. The role combines analytics, process improvement and cross-functional business support in an environment where procurement is expected to contribute visibly to margin improvement and operational discipline.


Your mission

Your mission will be to build the performance management and data foundation of Group Procurement across markets. You will help turn procurement activity into clear management insight, stronger prioritization and more consistent value delivery.


What You Will Do

  • Own and develop procurement KPIs, dashboarding and recurring performance reporting.
  • Create spend analyses and improve spend visibility by category, supplier and market.
  • Support savings pipeline management and realised value tracking together with finance and controlling.
  • Generate analyses that help prioritise categories, projects and procurement opportunities.
  • Review, simplify and update procurement processes, templates, manuals and governance material.
  • Improve supplier-related data and contribute to sustainability reporting readiness in priority areas.
  • Support the evaluation and practical use of tools that strengthen procurement ways of working.
  • Work closely with Group Procurement, local procurement teams, business controlling, asset management and sustainability.


What Success Looks Like In Your First 12 Months

  • A monthly procurement performance pack is established and used as part of the management rhythm.
  • Spend data is easier to access, categorize and use for procurement prioritization.
  • Savings pipeline and value tracking are structured through a finance-aligned methodology.
  • Key procurement processes and governance documents have been simplified and refreshed.
  • Supplier-data readiness for sustainability reporting is stronger and less dependent on manual collection.


What we are looking for

  • 2-3 years of relevant experience in procurement, procurement excellence, business analysis, business controlling, consulting or a related field.
  • A university degree in business, economics, supply chain or a comparable discipline.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience translating data into actions, insight and business cases.
  • Advanced Excel capability and experience with Power BI or a similar reporting tool.
  • Experience with KPI design, dashboards, reporting or performance management.
  • A good understanding of procurement, supplier-related analysis or adjacent business processes.
  • Experience improving processes, governance or ways of working in a business environment.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.


Nice to have

  • Experience from the real estate sector or another asset-heavy industry.
  • Experience from management consulting or a procurement-focused environment.
  • Exposure to spend analytics, supplier sustainability, ESG or supplier-data reporting topics.
  • SQL or similar data-handling skills.
  • German and/or Scandinavian language skills.


Who You Are

You are proactive, structured and comfortable creating momentum in areas that still need more structure. You enjoy working independently, but you also like engaging with stakeholders across functions and levels. You do not only produce analysis - you make it useful, visible and actionable.

Additional Information


Why join us

  • You will shape a capability, not only maintain one.
  • You will have high visibility and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
  • You will work across procurement, finance, sustainability and local markets.
  • You will combine analysis, process improvement and implementation in one role.

Title: Skab forretningsindsigter der påvirker beslutninger
Description:
Er du den der i en central rolle kan analysere, håndtere og synliggøre tallene for forretningen, så vi får omsat indsigter til forretningsbeslutninger?

I Andel Energi søger vi en erfaren kommerciel Forretnings- og Markedsanalytiker, der vil være med til at sikre, at vi træffer de rigtige beslutninger i en forretning under konstant udvikling.

"Vi står midt i en spændende fusion, hvor tre selskaber samles omkring en fælles måde at forstå og styre forretningen på. Vores analyser spiller en vigtig rolle i at skabe indsigt og retning, for at prioritere de indsatser, der giver værdi for både kunder og forretning” fortæller afdelingsleder Adin Gradascevic.

Vi udvikler fremtidens energiselskab

Du får en central rolle i krydsfeltet mellem analyse, økonomi og kommerciel forretning, hvor du er med til at understøtte beslutningskraften i Andel Energi. Som en del af Performance & Data afdelingen omsætter og formidler du indsigt til anbefalinger, der skaber retning og resultater.

Sammen med forretningen, finance og ledelsen arbejder du med spørgsmål som: Hvordan udvikler vores salg og kundeportefølje sig, og hvad driver udviklingen? Hvorfor performer vi bedre eller dårligere end forventet? Og hvor skal vi sætte ind for at løfte de kommercielle resultater, så vi gør det endnu lettere for danskerne at vælge grøn energi og elektrificere hverdagen?

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:


Drive og formidle performance på tværs af forretningen
Analysere udviklingen i salg, kundeadfærd og kommercielle KPI'er
Identificere muligheder og risici samt anbefale konkrete initiativer
Udarbejde analyser og beslutningsoplæg, der understøtter ledelsens beslutninger
Facilitere performancemøder med ledere og nøgleinteressenter og sikre, at aftalte indsatser følges til dørs
Videreudvikle KPI-strukturer, rapportering og styringsmodeller


Du vil opleve, at dine analyser ikke ender i en rapport, men bruges målrettet til at prioritere investeringer, forbedre kundeoplevelsen og forbedre vores position på et energimarked i hastig udvikling. Vores målsætning er klar: Vi vil skabe Danmarks største og mest innovative energiselskab.

En hverdag med både kommercielle indsigter og relationer

Din hverdag vil både bestå af løbende performance- og budgetopfølgning, facilitering af performancemøder, udvikling af rapportering og tæt dialog med forretningen. Du skal kunne gå fra det detaljerede datagrundlag til det større kommercielle billede - og formidle dine indsigter, så de kan omsættes til handling.

Det er en rolle for dig, der ikke blot vil fortælle, hvad der er sket, men også vil være med til at forstå hvorfor det sker, hvad det betyder for forretningen, og hvor vi skal sætte ind.

Du bliver en del af et team på tolv kolleger, hvor faglig sparring, samarbejde og fælles mål går hånd i hånd med en uformel og hjælpsom kultur.

Hvem er du?

Du er en erfaren analytiker med solid forretningsforståelse og et kommercielt mindset. Du motiveres af at skabe forretningsværdi gennem indsigter og trives med at arbejde tæt på beslutningstagere. Som person er du nysgerrig, initiativrig og trives med at udfordre eksisterende antagelser på en konstruktiv måde. Du følger op, skaber fremdrift og bidrager til et godt samarbejde omkring dig.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:


Har en relevant videregående uddannelse, fx cand.merc., og erfaring fra en abonnementsforretning eller anden kommerciel forretning
Har solid erfaring med performance management, kommercielle analyser og evnen til at omsætte indsigter til konkrete anbefalinger og handling
Er en dygtig formidler, der kan gøre komplekse sammenhænge enkle og relevante og skabe dialog på tværs af forretningen
Formidler komplekse emner på en klar og engagerende måde. Skaber fremdrift og gode relationer i dialogen mellem forskellige dele af forretningen
Er fortrolig med Excel og PowerPoint og bruger dem til at skabe overblik og formidle dine indsigter effektivt


Et Andel Energi i bevægelse – vil du med?

Lyder det som noget for dig, så send din ansøgning og dit CV via linket i annoncen. For at sikre gældende GDPR-lovgivning modtager vi kun ansøgninger via jobannoncen. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Adin Gradascevic på telefon nummer 28344037.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Vi afholder samtaler i to omgange. Første samtale er med afdelingsleder og handler primært om opgaveløsning og faglige kompetencer. Går du videre til anden samtale, vil du inden få en case samt besvare to analyser: en logisk og en adfærdsanalyse. Disse er udgangspunkt for dialogen til samtalen.

Første samtaler afholdes uge 43. Anden samtaler med case og analyser afholdes d.27 oktober.

Vil du vide mere om rekrutteringsproces og kultur kan du læse mere på vores koncernhjemmeside: andel.dk/karriere.

Vi kombinerer formål, faglighed og fællesskab

Hos Andel Energi kommer du til en arbejdsplads, der engagerer sig i at gøre det nemt for vores kunder at få en grønnere hverdag. Andel Energi er en del af det andelsejede Andel, og vi arbejder langsigtet og formålsdrevet for at skabe en grønnere fremtid. I vores organisation er der plads til nye idéer, forandringer og fællesskab – og vores kultur bygger på tillid og samarbejde.

Læs mere om Andel Energi på hjemmesiden: Andelenergi.dk.

#Andelenergi

Som kollega i Andel Energi er du en del af den grønne omstilling

I Andel Energi leverer vi el, naturgas og energirådgivning til mere end 1,2 mio. privat- og erhvervskunder. Som Danmarks største energiselskab har vi et stort ansvar for at sætte fart på den grønne omstilling.

Derfor arbejder vi for at skabe energiløsninger, som er gode for alle og gode for fremtiden. Det skal være let for alle at spare på energien og træffe grønne valg.

Andel Energi er en del af Andel, en andelsejet energi- og fibernetkoncern, der skaber velfærd og vækst i det danske samfund gennem leverance af vital infrastruktur og fremtidssikrede energiløsninger. Det gør vi, når vi investerer visionært i fibernet, vindmøller, energiløsninger og ladeinfrastruktur til elbiler. I Andel vil vi være hinandens bedste forbindelse. Vi har 2,8 millioner kundeforhold og 1.700 kolleger, der tager ansvar for at skabe en fælles fremtid – for vores kunder, andelshavere og vores omverden. Andel har hovedsæde i Svinninge og primære lokationer i Ballerup, Haslev og Virum.

I Andel Energi hylder vi fællesskabet og forskelligheden og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold at søge vores ledige stillinger.

Title: Datakonsulent til Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus (SDCA) - Innovation (1-årigt barselsvikariat), Aarhus Universitetshospital
Description:
Datakonsulent til Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus (SDCA) - Innovation (1-årigt barselsvikariat), Aarhus Universitetshospital,

Brænder du for at arbejde med sundhedsdata tæt på klinisk praksis, innovation og forskning? Og vil du være med til at omsætte data til løsninger, der bidrager til udvikling af diabetesområdet - både gennem dataleverancer til innovations- og forskningsprojekter og gennem udvikling af nye dataværktøjer til klinisk praksis?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til en stilling som datakonsulent ved SDCA Innovation - et 1-årigt barselsvikariat pr. 1. december 2026. Der kan eventuelt senere være mulighed for forlængelse. Du bliver en del af et lille hold med hhv. en datamanager og en data scientist, der har indgående kendskab til data inden for diabetesområdet og til sundheds- og BI-data i Region Midtjylland.

Hvem er vi?

SDCA er Region Midtjyllands kraftcenter på diabetesområdet og en organisation, hvor der er plads til udvikling, nysgerrighed og nye idéer. I stillingen bliver du en del af SDCA Innovation, en tværfaglig enhed med 25 medarbejdere, der arbejder med innovations- og designprocesser, digital udvikling, sundhedsdata, læring, adfærdsdesign, projektstyring og implementeringsstøtte.

Sammen med forskere og klinikere arbejder SDCA Innovation med at drive nyskabelse, implementering og udbredelse af nye løsninger, der skaber viden og værdi i praksis – både for personer med diabetes og for sundhedsvæsenet generelt.

Om stillingen

Som datakonsulent bliver du en central del af arbejdet med at skabe datadrevet indsigt og beslutningsstøtte på diabetesområdet. Du kommer både til at bidrage til innovationsprojekter, forskningsprojekter og udvikling af dataværktøjer, der understøtter klinisk praksis, kvalitetsudvikling og ledelsesbeslutninger. Stillingen spænder bredt, og du vil arbejde med hele processen fra afdækning af databehov, datastrukturering og -træk til visualisering og formidling af resultater.

For kandidater med interesse for data science vil der desuden være mulighed for at bidrage til projekter, hvor vi undersøger anvendelsen af AI- og machine learning-metoder på kliniske og driftsgenererede data.

Dine konkrete opgaver vil bestå af


opbygning af kendskab til datalandskabet i Region Midtjylland (BI-data), herunder korrekt databasehåndtering med henblik på dataleverancer og rådgivning
datamanagement i form af afklaring, strukturering og validering af sundhedsdata til brug i forbindelse med innovations- og kvalitetsudviklingsprojekter
udarbejdelse af visualiseringer, der understøtter behovsafdækning, projektudvikling, evaluering og beslutningstagning i innovationsprojekter og kvalitetsudvikling
dialog med klinikere, forskere, projektledere og andre interessenter om databehov, datakvalitet og fortolkning af data
udvikling af dashboards, datavisninger og dataværktøjer til sundhedsprofessionelle og ledelse på tværs af hospitalerne og på sigt også tværsektorielt
levering af data fra Region Midtjyllands datavarehus til større forskningsprojekter på diabetesområdet.


For kandidater med interesse for data science kan opgaverne desuden omfatte


bidrag til udvikling og validering af AI/ML løsninger på kliniske og driftsgenererede data
vurdering af klinisk anvendelighed og implementeringsmuligheder for datadrevne AI/ML beslutningsstøtteløsninger
deltagelse i netværk inden for AI, data science og digital sundhed.


Vi forventer af dig, at du


har erfaring i programmering (SQL og evt. R, Python el.lign)
kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
har gode kommunikations- og formidlingsevner og kan oversætte viden om data til kollegaer med andre fagligheder
kan arbejde team-orienteret og indgå i et tæt samarbejde, hvor man arbejder fleksibelt og integreret og hjælper hinanden i den daglige opgaveløsning
har en kandidatgrad inden for f.eks. sundhedsteknologi, folkesundhedsvidenskab, informationsvidenskab eller lignende.


Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har


erfaring med arbejde i sundhedssektoren
erfaring med Tableau, Power BI eller lignende visualiseringsværktøjer
kendskab til data governance, datakvalitet eller datamodellering
interesse og kendskab for AI og machine learning.


Vi kan tilbyde dig


et bredt arbejdsfællesskab med engagerede og tværfaglige kollegaer
at blive en del af en velfungerende enhed med et godt kollegialt og socialt sammenhold
en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at definere og udvikle dine opgaver
et job med stor mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling i en dynamisk organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og mulighed for selv at præge egne arbejdsopgaver.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest.

Kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte innovationschef Katrine Holm Lindgaard på tlf. 2370 7067 eller på mail katrln@rm.dk

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 14. oktober 2026 og vi forventer at holde samtaler d. 21. og 22. oktober 2026.

Om Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus

Vi tror på, at alle mennesker kan få et godt liv. Et liv fyldt med glæde, livskvalitet og mulighed for at træffe egne frie valg.

Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus er Region Midtjyllands udviklingscenter på diabetesområdet. Vi arbejder for, at mennesker med diabetes kan leve et godt liv - og knække kurven, så færre mennesker får diabetes. Vi udvikler og samarbejder om nye og innovative diabetesindsatser inden for behandling, forebyggelse, forskning og tværsektorielt samarbejde. I særlig grad til gavn for alle, som er påvirket af diabetes, men i høj grad også til gavn for det samlede danske sundhedsvæsen.

Vi er drevet og ejet af Region Midtjylland, støttet af en 10-årig bevilling fra Novo Nordisk Fonden og er fysisk placeret på Aarhus Universitetshospital.


Mød nogle af dine måske kommende kolleger.
Læs mere om Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus.
Følg os på LinkedIn.


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret til samtale.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Og vil du være med til at omsætte data til løsninger, der bidrager til udvikling af diabetesområdet - både gennem dataleverancer til innovations- og forskningsprojekter og gennem udvikling af nye dataværktøjer til klinisk praksis?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til en stilling som datakonsulent ved SDCA Innovation - et 1-årigt barselsvikariat pr. 1. december 2026. Der kan eventuelt senere være mulighed for forlængelse. Du bliver en del af et lille hold med hhv. en datamanager og en data scientist, der har indgående kendskab til data inden for diabetesområdet og til sundheds- og BI-data i Region Midtjylland.

Hvem er vi?

SDCA er Region Midtjyllands kraftcenter på diabetesområdet og en organisation, hvor der er plads til udvikling, nysgerrighed og nye idéer. I stillingen bliver du en del af SDCA Innovation, en tværfaglig enhed med 25 medarbejdere, der arbejder med innovations- og designprocesser, digital udvikling, sundhedsdata, læring, adfærdsdesign, projektstyring og implementeringsstøtte.

Sammen med forskere og klinikere arbejder SDCA Innovation med at drive nyskabelse, implementering og udbredelse af nye løsninger, der skaber viden og værdi i praksis – både for personer med diabetes og for sundhedsvæsenet generelt.

Om stillingen

Som datakonsulent bliver du en central del af arbejdet med at skabe datadrevet indsigt og beslutningsstøtte på diabetesområdet. Du kommer både til at bidrage til innovationsprojekter, forskningsprojekter og udvikling af dataværktøjer, der understøtter klinisk praksis, kvalitetsudvikling og ledelsesbeslutninger. Stillingen spænder bredt, og du vil arbejde med hele processen fra afdækning af databehov, datastrukturering og -træk til visualisering og formidling af resultater.

For kandidater med interesse for data science vil der desuden være mulighed for at bidrage til projekter, hvor vi undersøger anvendelsen af AI- og machine learning-metoder på kliniske og driftsgenererede data.

Dine konkrete opgaver vil bestå af

  • opbygning af kendskab til datalandskabet i Region Midtjylland (BI-data), herunder korrekt databasehåndtering med henblik på dataleverancer og rådgivning
  • datamanagement i form af afklaring, strukturering og validering af sundhedsdata til brug i forbindelse med innovations- og kvalitetsudviklingsprojekter
  • udarbejdelse af visualiseringer, der understøtter behovsafdækning, projektudvikling, evaluering og beslutningstagning i innovationsprojekter og kvalitetsudvikling
  • dialog med klinikere, forskere, projektledere og andre interessenter om databehov, datakvalitet og fortolkning af data
  • udvikling af dashboards, datavisninger og dataværktøjer til sundhedsprofessionelle og ledelse på tværs af hospitalerne og på sigt også tværsektorielt
  • levering af data fra Region Midtjyllands datavarehus til større forskningsprojekter på diabetesområdet.

For kandidater med interesse for data science kan opgaverne desuden omfatte

  • bidrag til udvikling og validering af AI/ML løsninger på kliniske og driftsgenererede data
  • vurdering af klinisk anvendelighed og implementeringsmuligheder for datadrevne AI/ML beslutningsstøtteløsninger
  • deltagelse i netværk inden for AI, data science og digital sundhed.

Vi forventer af dig, at du

  • har erfaring i programmering (SQL og evt. R, Python el.lign)
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • har gode kommunikations- og formidlingsevner og kan oversætte viden om data til kollegaer med andre fagligheder
  • kan arbejde team-orienteret og indgå i et tæt samarbejde, hvor man arbejder fleksibelt og integreret og hjælper hinanden i den daglige opgaveløsning
  • har en kandidatgrad inden for f.eks. sundhedsteknologi, folkesundhedsvidenskab, informationsvidenskab eller lignende.

Det er desuden en fordel, hvis du har

  • erfaring med arbejde i sundhedssektoren
  • erfaring med Tableau, Power BI eller lignende visualiseringsværktøjer
  • kendskab til data governance, datakvalitet eller datamodellering
  • interesse og kendskab for AI og machine learning.

Vi kan tilbyde dig

  • et bredt arbejdsfællesskab med engagerede og tværfaglige kollegaer
  • at blive en del af en velfungerende enhed med et godt kollegialt og socialt sammenhold
  • en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at definere og udvikle dine opgaver
  • et job med stor mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling i en dynamisk organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og mulighed for selv at præge egne arbejdsopgaver.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest.

Kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte innovationschef Katrine Holm Lindgaard på tlf. 2370 7067 eller på mail katrln@rm.dk

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 14. oktober 2026 og vi forventer at holde samtaler d. 21. og 22. oktober 2026.

Om Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus

Vi tror på, at alle mennesker kan få et godt liv. Et liv fyldt med glæde, livskvalitet og mulighed for at træffe egne frie valg.

Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus er Region Midtjyllands udviklingscenter på diabetesområdet. Vi arbejder for, at mennesker med diabetes kan leve et godt liv - og knække kurven, så færre mennesker får diabetes. Vi udvikler og samarbejder om nye og innovative diabetesindsatser inden for behandling, forebyggelse, forskning og tværsektorielt samarbejde. I særlig grad til gavn for alle, som er påvirket af diabetes, men i høj grad også til gavn for det samlede danske sundhedsvæsen.

Vi er drevet og ejet af Region Midtjylland, støttet af en 10-årig bevilling fra Novo Nordisk Fonden og er fysisk placeret på Aarhus Universitetshospital.

  • Mød nogle af dine måske kommende kolleger.
  • Læs mere om Steno Diabetes Center Aarhus.
  • Følg os på LinkedIn.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret til samtale.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk.

Title: BI & Analytics Developer
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
At itm8, we are investing heavily in data, analytics and AI. We are looking for a BI & Analytics Developer who can turn our Microsoft Fabric foundation into trusted insights, modern analytics experiences and real business value.

Our common data platform is taking shape. Now we need someone who can help shape how data is consumed, explored and visualised across itm8 - from semantic models and governed self-service to innovative analytics and decision-support tools.

Your Role

As our BI & Analytics Developer, you will help itm8 move from traditional reporting towards a modern analytics landscape built on Microsoft Fabric, trusted data products and user-friendly insight experiences.

Working with business stakeholders, platform colleagues and fellow BI developers, you will translate business needs into reusable data products, intuitive visualisations, semantic models and analytics solutions.

In practice, you will:


Design modern analytics, visualisation and decision-support solutions using Microsoft Fabric and relevant BI/analytics tools.
Build semantic models and investigate data lineage and quality issues so insights can be trusted.
Challenge traditional reporting approaches and find smarter ways to enable exploration, adoption and better decisions.


We Are Looking For a Teamm8 Who


Does not believe another classic dashboard is always the answer.
Enjoys investigating data, understanding where numbers come from and solving data quality issues.
Is curious, pragmatic and motivated by emerging analytics and visualisation technologies that people actually use.


What you bring

Mindset matters most, but ideally you bring:


Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, for example Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, OneLake, semantic models or related capabilities.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and reusable data products.
Experience with Power BI or comparable BI/visualisation tools, including modelling, report design and interactive insight experiences.
Comfortable with SQL and DAX; Python knowledge is a plus.
Experience with Git integration, CI/CD, version control and deployment pipelines.


It would be an advantage if you also have experience with


AI-assisted analytics, Copilot or similar tools that support insight generation.
Data storytelling, information design and modern visualisation practices.


What You Get

You will join a team evolving from traditional BI delivery towards Microsoft Fabric, modern analytics, data enablement, adoption and business impact.

You will influence how analytics, visualisation and decision support develop across itm8 and help create trusted data products for our continued AI journey.

About The Team

You will join the Data & Insights Team, which is part of itm8’s Global Transformation Management Office (TMO).

We are an international team with big ambitions. Our goal is to build strong data products and a team where people grow, learn and enjoy coming to work. We invest in professional development, encourage curiosity and experimentation, and believe that trust, collaboration and a good sense of humour are just as important as technical excellence.

Ready to join the team?

We look forward to receiving your CV and a cover letter.

If you have questions about the position, please contact Trine Lundorf, Director, Data & Insights, at +45 53 71 42 19 or at trlun@itm8.com. All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. We also obtain a criminal record certificate prior to employment.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Itm8

We are itm8 – our customers’ IT mate.

Behind us stand 1,600+ teammates across Denmark, Sweden, the Philippines and the Czech Republic. Specialists within everything from IT security and ERP to AI and software development.

But what connects us is not only technology. It is PURPLE POWER – our way of working. We help each other first, celebrate what works and cut through the bullshit. We believe in ambition over status quo. And we believe diversity makes us stronger.

At itm8, it is not about being perfect. It is about taking ownership, creating value and growing every day.

So ask yourself: What can you build today? Where could it take us tomorrow?

If that sounds like you, apply today and become our next teamm8.

Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Copenhagen, Denmark

About The Job

Are you at the start of your career and ready to help shape Saxo's balance sheet analytics, risk frameworks, and treasury decision-making through data, modelling and quantitative analysis?

We are looking for a talented and motivated Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our Market & Treasury Risk team within Risk Strategy & Treasury. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of treasury, risk management, quantitative modelling, and strategic decision-making.

Our team plays a central role in shaping Saxo's earnings profile and balance sheet risks, including liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk and capital risk. We develop and maintain the analytical frameworks, models and methodologies that support balance sheet optimisation, risk management and senior management decision-making across the organisation.

As part of the team, you will contribute to the development of quantitative models, risk metrics as well as analytical tools used to assess earnings, funding, liquidity and market risks. You will work closely with colleagues across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading and Technology, gaining broad exposure to the management of a modern international bank.

This role is particularly well suited to professionals in the earlier stages of their career looking to build deep expertise in treasury, risk management and quantitative analysis within an international banking environment.

Responsibilities

As our new Quantitative Risk Analyst, you will:


Develop and enhance quantitative models, methodologies, and risk measures relating to liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk, and capital management.
Build analytical models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide insights into earnings, funding, liquidity, and risk exposures.
Perform quantitative analysis of balance sheet developments, business initiatives, and market events to support risk and treasury decision-making.
Contribute to the automation and improvement of risk analytics using modern analytical tools and programming languages.
Assist in the development and validation of methodologies used for risk measurement, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading, Secured Finance, and Technology to deliver scalable analytical solutions.
Support the preparation of analysis and material for senior management, risk committees, and regulatory interactions.
Support the ongoing development of analytical frameworks such as Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), Value of Client Funds (VCF), stress-testing methodologies, and balance sheet optimisation tools.


Your profile

This role is ideally suited to candidates with around 4-5 years of relevant experience who are looking to further develop their quantitative, analytical, and banking expertise while taking on increasing responsibility and ownership. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience if they bring highly relevant expertise and a strong foundation within the areas covered by the role.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems through data, modelling, and quantitative analysis. You are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by understanding how financial and business decisions impact earnings, risk, and balance sheet performance.

You are comfortable working with data, challenging assumptions, and developing practical solutions while collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders.

In Addition, We Expect That You


Hold a relevant master's degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, physics, computer science or a related quantitative discipline.
Have experience with Python, SQL, R, AI/ML tools, or similar analytical and programming technologies
Possess strong quantitative and analytical skills, with experience working with complex datasets and modelling frameworks.
Enjoy developing models, analytical tools, and scalable solutions to support business decision-making.
Have an interest in financial markets, banking, treasury or risk management.
Communicate clearly and explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Nice To Have


Experience with liquidity risk, FTP, IRRBB, market risk, stress testing, or capital management.
Knowledge of banking products, financial markets, or asset and liability management.
Experience with data visualisation, automation, or large-scale data analysis.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks applicable to banks and financial institutions.


We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How To Apply

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Title: Legal Tech Operations Consultant
Description:
Vil du være med til at omsætte data og AI til konkrete løsninger på komplekse juridiske sager?




I Legal Tech Operations arbejder vi med data og teknologi, der skal fungere i en juridisk hverdag med høje krav til kvalitet, sporbarhed og sikkerhed. Du får ansvar for konkrete opgaver på rigtige sager og er med til at udvikle og forbedre de løsninger, der hjælper os med at levere juridisk rådgivning.




Bliv en del af Legal Tech Operations

Vi er et lille, teknisk stærkt team med ingeniører, data scientists og økonomer. Vi udvikler løsninger i tæt samarbejde med juristerne i huset - blandt andet ved at gøre store, ustrukturerede dokumentmængder til data, der kan analyseres og bruges i rådgivningen.




Det bliver en del af din hverdag

Du arbejder både praktisk med data fra konkrete sager og med at udvikle bedre metoder og værktøjer. Dine opgaver afhænger af din profil og de aktuelle sager, men kan blandt andet være at:




indsamle, udtrække, deduplikere og strukturere store dokumentmængder i forskellige filformater.
analysere sagsdata, finde mønstre og gennemføre stikprøvebaserede kvalitetskontroller.
løse konkrete data- og analyseopgaver på sager og omsætte erfaringerne til nye løsninger.
kvalitetssikre pipelines og modeller gennem test, stikprøver og systematisk evaluering.
rapportere og visualisere data, så jurister og klienter får et bedre overblik.




Afhængigt af opgaverne får du også mulighed for at arbejde med blandt andet RAG, embeddings, indeksering og evaluering af AI-løsninger, datapipelines, FastAPI, OCR og Azure AI Document Intelligence. Vi arbejder også med kildeverifikation, skemavalidering og deployment på egen infrastruktur med Docker.




Du får ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle dig

Du får ansvar tidligt, men du står ikke alene. Vi drøfter løbende sager, metoder og resultater i teamet, og du får sparring på dit arbejde. Du følger løsninger fra idé og prototype til brug på konkrete sager og får direkte feedback fra juristerne, der anvender dem.

Rollen giver dig mulighed for at udvikle dig i krydsfeltet mellem data science, AI og praktisk problemløsning. Du får erfaring med at bygge, evaluere og drive løsninger i en juridisk kontekst, hvor præcision og kvalitet har stor betydning.




Vi forestiller os, at du

Du er tidligt i din karriere og har et solidt fundament i dataanalyse og problemløsning. Du kan være nyuddannet inden for data science, matematik, økonomi, datalogi eller et beslægtet område, eller du kan have nogle års erfaring med eksempelvis softwareudvikling, data science eller teknologirådgivning.




Vi forventer, at du:




kan analysere data og formidle dine resultater klart.
arbejder systematisk og struktureret og har blik for detaljer.
tager korrekthed og sikkerhed alvorligt.
har lyst til at lære at udvikle, evaluere og drive løsninger - både med og uden AI.
kan arbejde professionelt på dansk og engelsk.




Studieprojekter, egne dataprojekter og relevant erhvervserfaring tæller positivt. Det er også en fordel, hvis du kender rådgivnings- eller advokatbranchen eller har arbejdet med eksempelvis Git eller Docker, men det er ikke et krav. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét. Har du et stærkt udgangspunkt, nysgerrighed og lyst til at udvikle dig, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.




Om os

Bech-Bruun er i toppen af danske advokatfirmaer. Vi rådgiver på tværs af erhvervsjuraens områder og arbejder tæt sammen - både med vores klienter og på tværs af specialer - for at skabe klarhed og et sikkert grundlag for beslutninger. Vi kombinerer dyb faglighed med et kommercielt blik og bruger blandt andet Legal Tech og AI til at styrke vores rådgivning.

Hos os bliver du udfordret af dygtige kolleger og får mulighed for at arbejde med komplekse juridiske problemstillinger, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og forretningsforståelse går hånd i hånd. Du får ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle dig gennem opgaverne og for at bringe dine egne kompetencer i spil.




Er du klar til næste skridt?

Er det dig, vi leder efter? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV via vores hjemmeside. Vi holder samtaler løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Senior Legal Tech Operations Manager Jonas William Abbotts på telefon 25 26 35 95 eller mail JWA@bechbruun.com.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!




Ansøgningsfristen er den 19. oktober 2026.

I Legal Tech Operations arbejder vi med data og teknologi, der skal fungere i en juridisk hverdag med høje krav til kvalitet, sporbarhed og sikkerhed. Du får ansvar for konkrete opgaver på rigtige sager og er med til at udvikle og forbedre de løsninger, der hjælper os med at levere juridisk rådgivning.


Bliv en del af Legal Tech Operations

Vi er et lille, teknisk stærkt team med ingeniører, data scientists og økonomer. Vi udvikler løsninger i tæt samarbejde med juristerne i huset - blandt andet ved at gøre store, ustrukturerede dokumentmængder til data, der kan analyseres og bruges i rådgivningen.


Det bliver en del af din hverdag

Du arbejder både praktisk med data fra konkrete sager og med at udvikle bedre metoder og værktøjer. Dine opgaver afhænger af din profil og de aktuelle sager, men kan blandt andet være at:


  • indsamle, udtrække, deduplikere og strukturere store dokumentmængder i forskellige filformater.
  • analysere sagsdata, finde mønstre og gennemføre stikprøvebaserede kvalitetskontroller.
  • løse konkrete data- og analyseopgaver på sager og omsætte erfaringerne til nye løsninger.
  • kvalitetssikre pipelines og modeller gennem test, stikprøver og systematisk evaluering.
  • rapportere og visualisere data, så jurister og klienter får et bedre overblik.


Afhængigt af opgaverne får du også mulighed for at arbejde med blandt andet RAG, embeddings, indeksering og evaluering af AI-løsninger, datapipelines, FastAPI, OCR og Azure AI Document Intelligence. Vi arbejder også med kildeverifikation, skemavalidering og deployment på egen infrastruktur med Docker.


Du får ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle dig

Du får ansvar tidligt, men du står ikke alene. Vi drøfter løbende sager, metoder og resultater i teamet, og du får sparring på dit arbejde. Du følger løsninger fra idé og prototype til brug på konkrete sager og får direkte feedback fra juristerne, der anvender dem.

Rollen giver dig mulighed for at udvikle dig i krydsfeltet mellem data science, AI og praktisk problemløsning. Du får erfaring med at bygge, evaluere og drive løsninger i en juridisk kontekst, hvor præcision og kvalitet har stor betydning.


Vi forestiller os, at du

Du er tidligt i din karriere og har et solidt fundament i dataanalyse og problemløsning. Du kan være nyuddannet inden for data science, matematik, økonomi, datalogi eller et beslægtet område, eller du kan have nogle års erfaring med eksempelvis softwareudvikling, data science eller teknologirådgivning.


Vi forventer, at du:


  • kan analysere data og formidle dine resultater klart.
  • arbejder systematisk og struktureret og har blik for detaljer.
  • tager korrekthed og sikkerhed alvorligt.
  • har lyst til at lære at udvikle, evaluere og drive løsninger - både med og uden AI.
  • kan arbejde professionelt på dansk og engelsk.


Studieprojekter, egne dataprojekter og relevant erhvervserfaring tæller positivt. Det er også en fordel, hvis du kender rådgivnings- eller advokatbranchen eller har arbejdet med eksempelvis Git eller Docker, men det er ikke et krav. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét. Har du et stærkt udgangspunkt, nysgerrighed og lyst til at udvikle dig, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.


Om os

Bech-Bruun er i toppen af danske advokatfirmaer. Vi rådgiver på tværs af erhvervsjuraens områder og arbejder tæt sammen - både med vores klienter og på tværs af specialer - for at skabe klarhed og et sikkert grundlag for beslutninger. Vi kombinerer dyb faglighed med et kommercielt blik og bruger blandt andet Legal Tech og AI til at styrke vores rådgivning.

Hos os bliver du udfordret af dygtige kolleger og får mulighed for at arbejde med komplekse juridiske problemstillinger, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og forretningsforståelse går hånd i hånd. Du får ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle dig gennem opgaverne og for at bringe dine egne kompetencer i spil.


Er du klar til næste skridt?

Er det dig, vi leder efter? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV via vores hjemmeside. Vi holder samtaler løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Senior Legal Tech Operations Manager Jonas William Abbotts på telefon 25 26 35 95 eller mail JWA@bechbruun.com.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!


Ansøgningsfristen er den 19. oktober 2026.

Title: Senior Performance Intelligence Manager
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you an analytical and technically strong performance manager who can translate complex R&D data into decision-ready insights? Do you have experience designing performance frameworks, KPI architectures, and portfolio intelligence capabilities that help senior leaders prioritize investments, strengthen business performance, and maximize innovation value?

Join our PMO, Innovation Portfolio Management within R&D Chronic Care organisation

Coloplast has a long history of developing innovative products that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the PMO department within the R&D Innovation Portfolio Management organization, where we drive portfolio management and execution across the innovation portfolio, enable strategy deployment, and advance performance management across the R&D organization.

As Senior Performance Intelligence Manager, you will play a key role in establishing a trusted performance management system across R&D. You will create a single source of truth for portfolio, functional, and organizational performance, enabling leaders across the organization to make better business decisions, strengthen business performance, and maximize the value delivered through innovation investments. Through KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, and performance insights, you will help leaders to drive continuous performance improvement across both the Innovation Value Stream portfolio and the wider R&D organization, ensuring leaders have the insights needed to improve outcomes, productivity, and value delivery

Turn performance insights into better R&D decisions

In this role, you move beyond traditional reporting. You will help build the performance foundation that gives R&D leadership one trusted view of performance and portfolio progress, risk and value — so they can act with confidence.

Your key responsibilities include:


Develop and maintain performance management framework and KPI matrix used to track value creation across the IVS portfolio and R&D organisation.
Design and build the Power BI data model, dashboards and reporting logic, from architecture through to visual design
Establish one trusted source of truth for portfolio, business and value performance, supporting better decisions and performance improvement across R&D and the Innovation Value Stream
Create one integrated portfolio view of milestones, cost, risk and value across programs and projects
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support value-optimising decisions for senior leadership
Work closely with Finance, R&D and IVS stakeholders to provide insights and analytical support that help leaders improve business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and make better business decisions
Develop and run value realization tracking, ensuring initiatives deliver against the impact they promised
Support portfolio scenario design and decision preparation with fact-based analysis
Apply hands-on BI, AI, data and analytics capabilities to improve reporting quality, automation and insight generation




Turn complexity into clear insights and recommendations

First and foremost, you are an analytical, technically strong performance manager who builds dashboards people actually trust. When you present a number, stakeholders don't question whether it's right — they ask what it means for the decision ahead.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy creating structure where complexity exists. You turn fragmented information into insights that leaders can act on, and you're motivated by building performance management practices that create real business value.

You combine business understanding with solid hands-on BI, data and analytics experience. You are comfortable working with data models, dashboards, reporting logic and performance metrics — and you can translate technical complexity into clear insights for senior stakeholders.

What you bring:


Minimum 5 years of experience in performance management, strategic PMO, portfolio management, business performance, or analytics-driven decision support
Master’s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Data/Analytics, Life Science, Technology or equivalent
Strong experience designing performance management frameworks, KPI architectures, dashboards, and decision-support capabilities in a project, program, or portfolio environment.
Solid hands-on technical experience building and developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modelling, reporting logic and visual design - this is a core, hands-on part of the role
Experience supporting portfolio scenario design, trade-off discussions and fact-based decision-making
Strong stakeholder management skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach
Experience from R&D, medical devices, pharma, life science or another regulated industry — this is an advantage
Communicate effortlessly in written and spoken English




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Anna Revva, Head of PMO, R&D Innovation Portfolio Management at dkanre@coloplast.com.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.
