Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Do you want to use data to shape decisions across the global research communications industry? Do you thrive on leading stakeholders from a business question to a data-driven action?

Location: London or Oxford

About Our Team

The Scientific, Technical & Medical Journals (STMJ) business, part of Elsevier, provides researchers with a trusted platform to publish and share their work. Publishing research across approximately 3,000 journals annually, STMJ plays a critical role in advancing scientific discovery and knowledge dissemination worldwide.

The STMJ Data & Analytics team is a global group of data professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and analytics that enable data-driven decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the team transforms complex data into actionable recommendations that drive performance, innovation, and customer value.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our STMJ Data & Analytics team. You will act as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders, leading complex analytics initiatives, independently managing projects, and helping to shape business decisions through data.

As a senior member of the team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy, serve as a subject matter expert, and support the development of junior analysts through coaching and knowledge sharing. You'll join a large, established team of data professionals that supports STMJ, with direct access to enterprise-grade platforms and tools, and be a part of a wider Elsevier organisation that's a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes worldwide.

Responsibilities


Lead complex analytics projects from planning through delivery, translating loosely defined business problems into a clear plan of action.
Act as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders, shaping strategy, guiding them through hypothesis driven thinking, and challenging assumptions through data.
Identify and execute the most relevant analyses, metrics, and reporting solutions.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while effectively prioritising workload.
Collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to overcome challenges and deliver results.
Continuously adapt to new tools and technologies, evaluating and adopting emerging techniques, including AI-assisted analytics, as the field evolves.
Coach and mentor junior data analysts, sharing best practices and analytical expertise.


Requirements


Demonstrated ability to influence decision-making through data-backed recommendations.
Proven experience managing projects and delivering results independently.
Good understanding of core analytics concepts, such as data modelling, blending, and visualization.
Experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Comfort operating in a fast-changing technical landscape and learning new tools, technologies, and analytical methodologies.
Experience within scholarly communications, publishing, or a related industry is advantageous but not essential.


Applicants must include a cover letter. This should clearly describe your interest in the role and how your skills, knowledge, and experience would contribute to the journal. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be reviewed.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work-life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people, with numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and flexible working arrangements to help you meet your personal and professional goals.

Working for you

Benefits

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:


Generous holiday allowance
Health and wellbeing benefits
Pension and savings plans
Life assurance and income protection
Flexible and hybrid working options
Employee assistance programmes
Learning and development opportunities


About Us

A global leader in information and analytics, Elsevier helps researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Our innovative solutions combine world-class scientific information with technology and analytics to help make research more effective and impactful.

If performed in NLD Amsterdam (Radarweg), the base pay range is €59,300 - €98,800. This job may be subject to a collective labor agreement in the Netherlands. Please consult with the hiring team for further details.

Title: Senior MI Analyst – Connected Mobility
Description:
About The Role

Connected Mobility is transforming the way Motability Operations understands and manages its fleet, using connected vehicle data such as vehicle health, mileage and diagnostic information to improve customer experience, operational efficiency and commercial outcomes.

We’re looking for a Senior MI Analyst specialising in Connected Mobility to join the Customer Services MI team. Reporting to the MI Partner Team Manager, you’ll take the analytical lead for Connected Mobility within CSMI, helping turn a growing and increasingly valuable source of vehicle data into actionable insight and measurable business value.

This is a hands-on analytical role. You’ll work with large and complex datasets, develop reporting and analytical products, investigate emerging trends and use connected vehicle data alongside our wider customer and operational data to build a more complete understanding of our customers and fleet.

You’ll be expected to go beyond responding to requests. You’ll proactively identify opportunities within the data, ask the right questions and translate your findings into clear recommendations that can improve customer outcomes, reduce cost and support better operational and commercial decisions.

As the senior analyst in this space, you’ll also help shape how Connected Mobility data is used across CSMI and the wider business, working closely with the Connected Mobility product team, data and technology colleagues and operational stakeholders.

About You

You’ll be passionate about using data to solve real business problems and comfortable working in a developing area where not every question or use case has already been defined.

You’ll be a proactive self-starter who is naturally curious about what the data is telling you. You’ll be confident exploring new datasets, forming hypotheses and identifying opportunities without waiting for someone to tell you exactly what analysis to undertake.

You’ll combine strong technical analytical skills with commercial and operational thinking. You’ll understand that producing the analysis is only part of the role — the real value comes from communicating what it means, recommending what should happen next and helping stakeholders turn insight into action.

You’ll be comfortable working across both technical and non-technical teams and able to translate between the two. You’ll build relationships proactively, challenge constructively and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks and blockers.

You’ll also enjoy developing others, sharing your knowledge and helping raise analytical capability across the wider team.

Minimum criteria

You’ll need all of these.


Proven experience within business intelligence, MI, data analytics or a related analytical role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience working with large and complex datasets.
Strong and proven SQL skills, with the ability to write clear, efficient queries and independently explore data, through complex data modelling.
Strong experience with analytical and visualisation tools such as Power BI and Excel.
Proven experience identifying trends, patterns and outliers and translating these into meaningful insight and recommendations.
Experience using customer, operational or commercial data to identify opportunities and deliver measurable improvements.
Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex analytical findings to non-technical audiences.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build effective relationships across multiple teams and disciplines.
The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and prioritise activity based on business impact.
Experience coaching, supporting or providing feedback to other analysts.
A strong focus on data quality, analytical accuracy and effective governance.


About The Company

Motability Operations is a unique organisation, virtually one of a kind. We combine a strong sense of purpose with a real commercial edge to ensure we provide the best possible worry-free mobility solutions to over 800,000 customers and their families across the UK. Customers exchange their higher rate mobility allowance to lease a range of affordable vehicles (cars, wheelchair accessible vehicles, scooters, and powered wheelchairs) with insurance, maintenance and breakdown assistance included. We are the largest car fleet operator in the UK (purchasing around 10% of all the new cars sold in the UK) and work with a network of around 5,000 car dealers and all the major manufacturers. We pride ourselves on delivering outstanding customer service, achieving an independently verified customer satisfaction rating of 9.8 out of 10.

Our Values Are At The Heart Of Everything We Do. They Represent Ambition, And We Look For Our People To Live And Breathe Them Every Day

We find solutions

We drive change

We care

As a Motability Operations team member, the benefits you can expect are:


Competitive reward package including an annual discretionary bonus
15% non-contributory pension (9% non-contributory pension during probation period)
28 days annual leave with option to purchase and sell days
1 day for volunteering
Funded Private Medical Insurance cover
Electric/Hybrid Car Salary Sacrifice Scheme and Cycle to Work Scheme
Life assurance at 4 times your basic salary to give you a peace of mind that your loved ones will receive some financial help
Funded health screening for over 50s
Voluntary benefits: charitable giving, critical illness insurance, dental insurance, health and cancer screenings for you and your partner, discounted gym memberships and season ticket loans
Employee Discount Scheme with an app to save on the go
Free access to healthcare apps such as Peppy, Unmind, Aviva Digital GP and volunteering app on Hand for all employees
Generous family leave policies


At Motability Operations, we believe in building a diverse workforce, where our people are empowered to attend work as their true selves, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We want to sustain a culture that nurtures, where employees are free to flourish and where they’re rewarded equally, regardless of race, nationality or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, age, disability, or gender.

We pride ourselves on being an inclusive employer and as such, all our offices provide first rate disability access. With our hybrid working environment, we do our best to accommodate part-time and flexible working requests where possible, building on our culture of trust, empowerment, and flexibility.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Your Role At Veezu

As a Data Analyst you handle the delivery of data solutions to key stakeholders and play a key role in helping us to grow the business and enhance our market position. Reporting into the VP of Performance and Data Science, your role will involve analysing, transforming, and validating complex datasets to drive operational KPIs.

Who are Veezu?

Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!

What You’ll Do


Analyse data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into actionable insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and develop practical dashboards and outputs.
Take ownership over and maintain key reporting infrastructure around KPIs for senior stakeholders across the business.
Perform ad hoc reports for key stakeholders by collecting, analysing, and reporting requested and relevant data.
Ensure data accuracy and reliability by validating reporting data and investigating discrepancies.
Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders to support data driven decision making.
Be committed to maintaining our ISO27001 certification and set high standards for Information Security compliance.


What You’ll Need


Relevant analytics qualification or background.
Proven SQL skills, for data extraction and transformation.
Track record of presenting data and findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience in Power BI or similar software.
Advanced skills in Google Sheets or MS Excel.
Ability to gather and translate reporting requirements from stakeholders into practical outputs.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret market data, identify trends and make data-driven decisions.
Familiarity with data governance, data management, and regulatory requirements related to reporting.


Where You’ll Be


This role is hybrid, with your base being your home address. However, it is expected that you could work from our Cardiff HQ and other locations as necessary for a minimum of 1 day per month


Veezu is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment, welcoming applications from all backgrounds, experiences, and communities.

Title: Senior Data Analyst II
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Are you excited by the opportunity to turn complex business questions into trusted data products and analytics solutions?

Would you enjoy combining analytics, stakeholder partnership and emerging AI techniques to help shape data-driven decision-making?

Location: Oxford

About Our Team

Our STMJ (Science, Technology, and Medical Journals) team publishes high-quality, peer-reviewed research that drives progress across scientific and medical disciplines. We collaborate closely with authors, editors, reviewers, and societies to ensure the integrity and impact of the published work. Through innovation in editorial workflows and publishing technology, we help global research communities discover, evaluate, and disseminate knowledge that advances science and improves lives.

The STMJ Data & Analytics team is a global group of data professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and analytics that enable data-driven decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the team transforms complex data into actionable recommendations that drive performance, innovation, and customer value.

About The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will own complex data products and solutions from initial business questions through to delivery. You will partner with senior stakeholders and technical colleagues, contributing hands-on to data models and semantic layers for AI-based solutions while helping the team deliver reliable, reusable outcomes at pace.

Responsibilities


Own and manage complex analytics projects from planning through delivery, translating loosely defined business questions into the right data solutions to address them
Collaborate directly with product managers, analytics engineers and other technologists on data product and solution development, applying governance principles to ensure our products are reliable and reusable
Engage and influence internally, acting as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders, playing a direct role in shaping strategy and advocating for data-driven decision making
Continuously adapt to new tools and technologies, adopting emerging techniques to improve our end solutions and critically, our speed of delivery
Play a direct role in levelling up the team by coaching junior colleagues in business engagement, analysis design and end-to-end project management


Requirements


Substantial experience in a data-oriented role is essential, as is a proven track record of owning and managing complex projects to delivery
Flexibility, speed and a bias for action are a must. Our team moves fast and so must you
You are a confident and clear communicator who can influence both senior and technical stakeholders
You are detail-orientated and a critical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills
You have strong experience in data preparation and blending, whether in Excel, Snowflake or other data platforms
Knowledge of AI assisted product development practices is an advantage, but not essential
Experience in scholarly publishing, research or a related industry is an advantage, but not essential


Applicants must include a cover letter. This should clearly describe your interest in the role and how your skills, knowledge, and experience would contribute to the team. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be reviewed.

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

About The Business

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.

Description:
Ready to turn complex data into powerful insights that shape the future of home improvement? Join Wickes as our new Senior Data Analyst.




Role Purpose:

At Wickes, we’re on a mission to create simple, digital-first experiences that help our customers build, repair, and improve their homes. Behind every great project is great data. As our new Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be at the heart of our data-driven decision-making, supporting various departments with advanced analytics, decision support, MI scoping, and hands-on training.




This role is based in Watford with occasional travel to Northampton.




What you’ll be doing:

Deep Dive Analysis: Deliver detailed, relevant insights that empower business areas to make smart, impactful decisions.
Data Lake Development: Collaborate with key stakeholders and fellow analysts to shape the development of our Data Lake, recommending and implementing robust analytical solutions.
Reporting & Governance: Own data tables management, manage business rules and logic, and ensure top-tier data quality assurance, accuracy, and confidentiality across all systems.
Empowering the Business: Support company reporting needs, maintain robust processes for team best practice, and champion super-user "spokes" across the business to foster self-sufficiency.
Documentation & Training: Create user manuals, documentation, and training materials that translate complex IT and data concepts into clear, accessible guidance for non-technical colleagues.




What we’re looking for:

Relevant professional or industry training, including advanced SQL and Data Analysis.
5+ years of BI and data experience, with a strong background in business partnering.




Skills & Technical Knowledge

Expert proficiency with BI tools and cloud data warehouse technologies (e.g., BigQuery), with confidence handling large datasets.
Strong understanding of SQL databases, star and snowflake schema modelling, and building both basic and complex queries.
Functional and technical competence in Google reporting and data warehouse architecture.
Exceptional communication skills, capable of explaining complex data simply, managing projects end-to-end, and providing first-line user support and triage.
Collaborative team player who is energetic, proactive, well-organised, and responsive to competing priorities.




What can we offer you?

You’ll be supported with fantastic learning and development and have the opportunity to grow and develop your career with us. We also have an early careers network to support you if you’re in your first few years of your career.




We’ll also equip you with a benefits package that includes:

Competitive bonus
Save-as-you-earn scheme
Private Medical and Life Assurance
Enhanced contributory pension scheme
Colleague discount




Discount platform including savings and cash back at numerous retailers, savings on gym membership, cycle to work scheme

Our widely recognised wellbeing strategy is something we’re proud of at Wickes. As part of this, we offer a range of health and wellbeing benefits and support, including an Employee Assistance Programme, financial education & loans, and access to parental, menopause and fertility support.

By giving you the support you need to do well at work, and the flexibility to make life work for you. We are giving you a career that doesn’t put your life on hold. Where you can be yourself, do your best work, and make a positive difference every day.




About Us:

Wickes is a multi-channel retailer operating in the home improvement market. With 50 years in industry, Wickes now generates revenue in excess of £1.6bn across 230 stores delivered by 8,000+ colleagues. But it is our culture that is considered our best kept secret; it’s a collaborative, down to earth, fun and inclusive environment where people feel part of a winning team. All our colleagues come from different backgrounds, but what we all have in common is a determination to succeed and a passion for being the best we can be. If that sounds like you, we’ll make you feel right at home.




We aim to create an inclusive workplace with colleagues’ wellbeing at the heart of everything we do.




We’re a Disability Confident Employer and committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
EXL (NASDAQ: EXLS) is a global data and artificial intelligence ("AI") company that offers services and solutions to reinvent client business models, drive better outcomes and unlock growth with speed. EXL harnesses the power of data, AI, and deep industry knowledge to transform businesses, including the world’s leading corporations in industries including insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, media and retail, among others. EXL was founded in 1999 with the core values of innovation, collaboration, excellence, integrity and respect.

We are headquartered in New York and have more than 60,000 employees spanning six continents. For more information, visit www.exlservice.com.




Role Title: Data Analyst

BU/Segment: Analytics

Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid working 3 days a week in the client office)

Employment Type: Permanent




Summary of the role:

EXL is looking for a Data Analyst with a passion for sports who will play a key role in providing analytics support to a client within our Sports, Media and Entertainment practice. Based in London, the role sits within the International Fan Data & Analytics team, supporting fanbase growth and engagement across international markets.




The primary responsibility of this role is to turn large, complex fan datasets into clear insights that help business stakeholders make better decisions. Working hands-on with SQL, Python and cloud data platforms such as Databricks, AWS and Snowflake, you will build the analysis, reporting and audience segments that power international marketing campaigns and track performance against growth goals. You will work with a dynamic team and will have real ownership of, and impact on, the analysis and data products you deliver.




The ideal candidate brings 2–5 years of analytics experience, strong technical skills and an understanding of the fan lifecycle, combined with the ability to translate business questions into well-structured analysis, explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences, and work closely with marketing, international and data engineering teams to deliver measurable value.

If you’re a passionate sports fan who enjoys solving problems with data – and you thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments – we’d love to connect.




As part of your duties, you will be responsible for:

Data Analysis

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, clean, transform and analyse large fan and marketing datasets.
Work within cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) to build and maintain analytical datasets and workflows.
Take a business question, develop an analysis plan, and deliver an answer that addresses it.
Summarise large data outputs into clear, business-friendly takeaways for stakeholders.




Reporting & Performance Tracking

Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports on fan growth, engagement and lifecycle metrics across international markets.
Monitor campaign and go-to-market (GTM) performance using agreed KPIs and success criteria.
Contribute to regular performance updates for team leads and senior stakeholders.




Campaign & Audience Enablement

Prepare audience segments and data for 1:1 marketing campaigns, including test/control groups.
Support segmentation analysis that helps regional teams deepen fan engagement in local markets.




Data Quality & Collaboration

Support user acceptance testing (UAT) of database changes and updates.
Help data engineering teams with root cause analysis (RCA) of data issues and bugs.
Work with marketing, international and data engineering teams to gather and document business requirements.
Liaise with third-party partners on data needs and definitions.




Qualifications and experience we consider to be essential for the role:

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
2–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations and window functions.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis (e.g., pandas, NumPy).
Hands-on experience with at least one cloud data platform: Databricks, AWS or Snowflake.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.
Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences




Skills and Personal attributes we would like to have:

Experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
Experience in marketing, CRM or customer analytics.
Knowledge of consent management, identity resolution or UK GDPR.
Experience in a consulting or client-facing environment.
Passion for sport and an understanding of global fan cultures.




As part of a leading global Data and AI company, you can look forward to:

A competitive salary with a generous bonus, private healthcare, critical illness life assurance at 4 x your annual salary, income protection insurance, and a rewarding pension.
EXL provides everyday financial well-being solutions, such as cash back cards, in which you can earn cashback while enjoying discounts, promotions, and offers from top retailers. We also offer a Cycle Scheme where you can save money on bikes and cycling accessories.
At EXL, we are committed to providing our employees with the tools and resources they need to succeed and excel in their careers. We offer a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities. We also support a range of learning initiatives that allow our employees to build on their existing skills and knowledge. From online courses to seminars and workshops, our employees have the opportunity to enhance their skills and stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, EXL is committed to diversity. Our company does not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, age, or disability status.
EXL employees are eligible to purchase stock as part of our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
At EXL, we offer a flexible hybrid working model that allows employees to live a balanced, healthy lifestyle while strengthening our culture of collaboration




To be considered for this role, you must already be eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Description:
Do you want to use data to shape decisions across the global research communications industry? Do you thrive on leading stakeholders from a business question to a data-driven action?

Location: London or Oxford

About Our Team

The Scientific, Technical & Medical Journals (STMJ) business, part of Elsevier, provides researchers with a trusted platform to publish and share their work. Publishing research across approximately 3,000 journals annually, STMJ plays a critical role in advancing scientific discovery and knowledge dissemination worldwide.

The STMJ Data & Analytics team is a global group of data professionals dedicated to delivering high-quality insights and analytics that enable data-driven decision-making. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, the team transforms complex data into actionable recommendations that drive performance, innovation, and customer value.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our STMJ Data & Analytics team. You will act as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders, leading complex analytics initiatives, independently managing projects, and helping to shape business decisions through data.

As a senior member of the team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy, serve as a subject matter expert, and support the development of junior analysts through coaching and knowledge sharing. You'll join a large, established team of data professionals that supports STMJ, with direct access to enterprise-grade platforms and tools, and be a part of a wider Elsevier organisation that's a global leader in information and analytics, helping researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes worldwide.

Responsibilities


Lead complex analytics projects from planning through delivery, translating loosely defined business problems into a clear plan of action.
Act as a trusted thought partner to senior stakeholders, shaping strategy, guiding them through hypothesis driven thinking, and challenging assumptions through data.
Identify and execute the most relevant analyses, metrics, and reporting solutions.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously while effectively prioritising workload.
Collaborate with cross-functional business and technical teams to overcome challenges and deliver results.
Continuously adapt to new tools and technologies, evaluating and adopting emerging techniques, including AI-assisted analytics, as the field evolves.
Coach and mentor junior data analysts, sharing best practices and analytical expertise.


Requirements


Demonstrated ability to influence decision-making through data-backed recommendations.
Proven experience managing projects and delivering results independently.
Good understanding of core analytics concepts, such as data modelling, blending, and visualization.
Experience balancing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
Comfort operating in a fast-changing technical landscape and learning new tools, technologies, and analytical methodologies.
Experience within scholarly communications, publishing, or a related industry is advantageous but not essential.


Applicants must include a cover letter. This should clearly describe your interest in the role and how your skills, knowledge, and experience would contribute to the journal. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be reviewed.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work-life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people, with numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and flexible working arrangements to help you meet your personal and professional goals.

Working for you

Benefits

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:


Generous holiday allowance
Health and wellbeing benefits
Pension and savings plans
Life assurance and income protection
Flexible and hybrid working options
Employee assistance programmes
Learning and development opportunities


About Us

A global leader in information and analytics, Elsevier helps researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes. Our innovative solutions combine world-class scientific information with technology and analytics to help make research more effective and impactful.

We are Awaze, Europe’s largest managed vacation rentals and holiday resorts business, bringing together some of the continent’s most recognised travel brands, including cottages.com, Hoseasons, NOVASOL and James Villa Holidays.




With more than 1.5 million bookings every year, 100,000+ properties and customers across Europe, we already operate at serious scale. But the next chapter for Awaze is about much more than scale.




We’re embarking on an ambitious AI transformation that will reshape how our customers discover, plan and book their holidays, and how our engineering teams build the technology behind those experiences.




Our strategy spans AI-powered search, natural-language discovery, intelligent recommendations, richer property data and AI-assisted engineering, all underpinned by a platform built around speed, trust, quality and real-time data.




Position: BI Analyst




🏡 About the role




As part of our growing Analytics team, you will work closely with our Revenue Management teams, playing a key role in helping us make data-driven decisions, optimising performance, and enhancing our operational strategy within our the Revenue Management function.




🏡 Your day-to-day responsibilities




Extract, manipulate, and analyse large datasets using SQL to generate insights.
Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau.
Monitor and report on key performance metrics.
Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities to improve commercial & revenue performance.
Work closely with cross-functional teams to support decision-making with real-time data.
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across reports.
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders in a clear and actionable manner.




🏡 Skills & Experience Required




SQL Expertise – Strong experience in writing queries and working with databases.
Proficiency in Tableau – Ability to build compelling dashboards and visualisations.
AI Tooling - we're embedding Claude within our reporting hub and experience with Claude would be highly advantageous.
Analytical Mindset – Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Commercial Awareness – Ability to translate data into business driven decisions.
Additional Tools - Experience with other BI tools such as Power BI, Looker, or Google Data Studio.
Web development skills - Knowledge of HTML and webpage development would be useful.
Strong mathematical foundation – expertise in areas such as econometrics, game theory, and behavioural economics are a plus but by no means essential.
Prior industry experience - e-commerce, marketplace platforms, or travel tech preferred.




🏡 What will we offer you?




At Awaze, we’re building a world-class data function front and centre of our growth and innovation strategy. You’ll have the opportunity to work on high-impact projects, shape the future of revenue & pricing, and be part of a forward-thinking, collaborative team.




Plus you'll also receive the following:




Annual Bonus Scheme
25 days holidays plus bank holidays
Holiday Discounts across our network
Pension contribution scheme
Private healthcare
Hybrid working (2 days in Mcr office per week)
Training & certifications

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Your Role At Veezu

As a Data Analyst you handle the delivery of data solutions to key stakeholders and play a key role in helping us to grow the business and enhance our market position. Reporting into the VP of Performance and Data Science, your role will involve analysing, transforming, and validating complex datasets to drive operational KPIs.

Who are Veezu?

Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more!

What You’ll Do


Analyse data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into actionable insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and develop practical dashboards and outputs.
Take ownership over and maintain key reporting infrastructure around KPIs for senior stakeholders across the business.
Perform ad hoc reports for key stakeholders by collecting, analysing, and reporting requested and relevant data.
Ensure data accuracy and reliability by validating reporting data and investigating discrepancies.
Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders to support data driven decision making.
Be committed to maintaining our ISO27001 certification and set high standards for Information Security compliance.


What You’ll Need


Relevant analytics qualification or background.
Proven SQL skills, for data extraction and transformation.
Track record of presenting data and findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience in Power BI or similar software.
Advanced skills in Google Sheets or MS Excel.
Ability to gather and translate reporting requirements from stakeholders into practical outputs.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret market data, identify trends and make data-driven decisions.
Familiarity with data governance, data management, and regulatory requirements related to reporting.


Where You’ll Be


This role is hybrid, with your base being your home address. However, it is expected that you could work from our Cardiff HQ and other locations as necessary for a minimum of 1 day per month


Veezu is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment, welcoming applications from all backgrounds, experiences, and communities.

Senior Commercial Cost Analyst (Industrial)

Reporting to: Head of Commercial

Role Summary

The Senior Commercial Cost Analyst is responsible for providing commercial administration, reporting, cost analysis and financial control support across the Industrial division. The role works closely with Project Managers, Operational Managers, Commercial and Finance teams to ensure project costs, revenues and commercial information are accurately maintained, reported and controlled throughout the project lifecycle.

The position plays a key role in supporting commercial decision-making through the provision of accurate financial reporting, cost analysis, forecasting and performance monitoring. The role is responsible for identifying commercial risks and opportunities, maintaining robust reporting processes, and ensuring compliance with company procedures, governance requirements and contractual obligations.

The Senior Commercial Cost Analyst supports the management of lower-value and lower-risk contracts whilst providing detailed commercial insight that enables improved project performance, profitability and cash flow management across the division.

Key Responsibilities


Work in accordance with Wilmott Group and subsidiary company procedures, using bespoke systems and complying with ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards.
Produce accurate and timely commercial and financial reports for senior stakeholders.
Prepare and maintain Cost Value Reconciliations (CVRs), including condensed CVR reporting for high-risk projects.
Analyse actual costs, budgets, forecasts and variances to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
Maintain commercial risk registers and Level 1 commercial master trackers.
Develop and maintain commercial dashboards, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and performance metrics.
Support operational teams in the implementation and continuous improvement of reporting dashboards.
Provide detailed analysis of revenue, margins, profitability and project cost drivers.
Participate in weekly project progress reviews and monthly project health meetings with operational leadership.
Monitor project, contract and operational costs against approved budgets and forecasts.
Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements, working closely with Project Management and Procurement teams.
Support contract administration activities, including applications for payment, invoicing and retention tracking.
Ensure accurate cost allocation and accounting treatment in line with business requirements.
Partner with operational and commercial managers to improve financial performance and project outcomes.
Present analysis, insights and recommendations to senior leadership teams.
Ensure compliance with commercial governance frameworks and financial controls.
Maintain high standards of data integrity, reporting accuracy and commercial record keeping.
Support internal and external audit activities and provide commercial reporting documentation as required.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives across commercial reporting processes.
Identify and implement reporting enhancements and process automation opportunities.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Senior Commercial Cost Analyst will be measured against the following key performance indicators:


Customer Invoicing Performance
Achieve monthly customer invoicing targets as agreed by Finance and the Head of Commercial.
Ensure invoicing is accurate, complete and submitted within agreed timescales.
Support the achievement of cash flow and working capital objectives through timely invoicing.
Goods Received Note (GRN) Performance
Achieve monthly GRN matching targets for supplier invoices as agreed by Finance and the Head of Commercial.
Ensure supplier invoice matching is completed accurately and within agreed timescales.
Promptly resolve discrepancies to maintain accurate cost reporting and financial control.
Cost Value Reconciliation (CVR) Reporting
Prepare and complete monthly CVRs for all designated high-risk projects.
Deliver CVRs within agreed reporting deadlines to support operational reviews.
Provide accurate cost, value, margin and risk analysis for review with the Head of Project Delivery (Industrial).


Essential

Knowledge, Skills and Experience


Experience in a Commercial Analyst, Cost Analyst, Commercial Administrator, Quantity Surveying support or similar commercial role.
Strong understanding of project cost control, budgeting, forecasting and Cost Value Reconciliations (CVRs).
Experience analysing financial and commercial data to identify risks, trends and opportunities.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency in commercial reporting systems.
Ability to interpret financial data and provide meaningful commercial insight.
Excellent numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Strong organisational and time-management skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across commercial, finance and operational teams.


Desirable


Experience within the construction, industrial, engineering or infrastructure sectors.
Knowledge of contract administration, payment applications and retention management.
Experience creating performance dashboards and management information reports.
Experience using ERP, commercial management or project control systems.
A relevant qualification in Finance, Commercial Management, Business or a related discipline.

Title: PPC Executive - Expression of interest
Description:
We’re looking for an ambitious and analytical Executive to join our Paid Media team. If you have mastered the foundational basics of digital advertising and are ready to step up and take true ownership of campaign-level performance, this is the perfect role for you.

SALARY: £25,500

See our: Impression's Benefits Booklet to find out more

The Role:

This is a dynamic position, working within our PPC team. You won't just be pulling levers or pulling reports; we want you to dig into the "why" behind the numbers across the entire media mix. You will take raw data and turn it into compelling stories, actively proposing new tactics, and setting up rigorous experiments to improve performance on both search engines and social platforms.

At Impression, we believe in nurturing talent. You will be fully supported by a brilliant team of Strategists who will help you refine your technical craft across Google, Microsoft and beyond. We will help you deepen your commercial awareness, build your confidence in presenting insights, and provide you with all the tailored training you need to eventually step up into a dual-channel Strategist role.

What we're looking for:

The Craft: Cross-Channel Execution & Automation


Multi-Platform Campaign Mastery: You will confidently set up, manage, and optimise campaigns across Search (e.g., Google PMax, Shopping). You’ll take a hands-on approach to optimising product feeds, creative assets, and audiences to ensure maximum relevance.
Bidding & Algorithm Management: You will select and implement the most appropriate automated bidding strategies based on campaign objectives. We want you to deeply understand the different levers that influence search intent algorithms, and clearly explain the rationale behind your choices.
Tactical Planning & Experimentation: You will actively contribute to the client roadmap by proposing data-driven tactics and cross-channel experiments that align with the overarching strategy our Senior Strategists have set.


Data Storytelling & Analytics


Beyond the Click: You will confidently use Google Analytics and other platforms to gain deeper insights into post-click user behavior, understanding how social awareness drives search intent, and creating custom reports to find hidden areas for improvement.
Data Storytelling: You will extract and interpret complex datasets from multiple platforms, transforming raw data into clear, actionable recommendations. You will always pair your data with important contextual factors without ever compromising on delivering the hard facts.
Campaign Ownership: You will take proud ownership of campaign-level KPIs across PPC, ensuring they are tracked accurately and that you are constantly working to improve them.


Market Intelligence & Teamwork


Competitor Analysis: You will proactively analyse competitor activity and market trends across the digital landscape to identify opportunities and threats. You will translate these insights into actionable recommendations for bidding, targeting, and ad copy/creative.
Knowledge Sharing: You will present your insights clearly to both the internal team and our clients. You'll share your cross-channel findings with the wider department to help inform strategic decisions and sharpen our overall competitive offering.
Commercial Awareness: You will demonstrate clear commercial awareness by always explaining how your proposed tactics and daily optimisations are expected to positively impact the client's actual business goals.


About You

2+ years of experience in e-commerce or digital marketing.
Strong analytical skills and data-driven mindset.
Knowledge of web analytics tools and e-commerce platforms.
Proactive, organized, and customer-focused.

Title: Water Resources Planning Specialist
Description:
Joining ARUP




Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.




We work across the entire water cycle, with utilities, local and regional governments, commercial and domestic water users and other partners. From designing and maintaining key water infrastructure to advising on natural catchments and flood defences, we help clients to consider the long-term economic, environmental and social dimensions of their proposals.




The opportunity




We are seeking a Water Resources Planning Specialist to join our growing Water Resources team, supporting water companies to develop resilient, sustainable and evidence-based plans to meet future water needs.




Water resources planning is central to responding to climate change, population growth, environmental protection and long-term resilience. Working across Water Resource Management Plans, Drought Plans, regional planning studies and Strategic Resource Options, you will help clients make informed decisions about future water supplies, drought resilience and investment priorities.




This is primarily a technical specialist role, rather than a project management position. You will take ownership of defined technical work packages, working alongside specialists in hydrology, environmental assessment, economics, engineering and digital delivery to develop robust planning evidence and clear recommendations.




The Role Will Focus On




Water resources planning, strategy development and supply-demand balance assessment.
Drought resilience, adaptive planning and climate change scenario testing.
Water resources modelling, data analysis and interpretation of planning evidence.
Option appraisal, best-value planning and Strategic Resource Options.
Environmental and regulatory assessment, including SEA, HRA and WFD-related inputs.
Clear technical reporting, client workshops, consultations and regulatory submissions.




Is this role right for you?




If you have all or some of the skills and experience below, and a passion for making a difference in the water sector - we’d love to hear from you.




Experience in water resources planning, water company planning, hydrology, environmental assessment or a related discipline.
A degree, or equivalent experience, in water resources, civil engineering, environmental engineering, geography, environmental science, hydrology or a related subject.
Understanding of WRMPs, Drought Plans, supply-demand balance assessment and resilience planning.
Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience analysing technical or environmental datasets.
Ability to prepare clear technical reports and communicate complex information simply.
Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.




Desirable

Experience supporting SROs or regional planning studies.
Knowledge of water resources and drought planning guidance, including relevant methods and emerging issues.
Knowledge of climate change adaptation, adaptive planning, options appraisal or best-value planning.
Understanding of SEA, HRA or WFD.
Experience with GIS, spatial analysis, digital delivery, regulatory submissions or consultation.
Chartered status, or progress towards chartership, with CIWEM, ICE or another relevant institution.




You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. If you bring relevant experience, strong analytical skills and a willingness to keep learning, we would like to hear from you.




This role is intended for an established technical professional who is developing recognised expertise in water resources planning. You will lead defined technical work packages, provide high-quality planning advice and contribute to major water resources programmes, with support from senior specialists and project managers on overall project leadership and commercial management.




Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.




What We Offer You




At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.




Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.




We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.




We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.




Different people, shared values




Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.




Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup




We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact maria.mindrut@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.




Our Application Process




To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/arup-careers-uk-application-process




Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Recruitment Agencies - We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
At MHR, our employees are central to our success and play a key role in helping customers achieve sustainable high performance. With a team of over 900 professionals, we work to make things flow smoothly, whether it's for large organisations or individual employees. As businesses face rapid changes in the world of work, our team is here to help them adapt and thrive. 

By focusing on the core needs of efficiency, productivity, growth, and impact, our employees use their expertise to deliver real solutions through our People and Finance platform. This system, which covers finance, HR, payroll, and learning, helps businesses run more smoothly and make better decisions in real time.

With over 40 years of experience behind us, MHR’s track record as a high-performance organisation is built on clear goals, a shared vision, and strong communication - all of which we pass on to our customers. 

MHR is more than just a place to work; it’s a platform for empowerment. Joining us means bringing innovation, technology, and teamwork seamlessly removes obstacles, enhances your skills, and allow you to focus on what’s most important to you- work that matters.

With us, you’ll grow, find your flow, and make a lasting difference in your career, your team, and your impact. 

Your Career

As a Data Engineer at MHR, you'll join a supportive team where you'll develop hands-on experience with modern cloud and data technologies while learning from experienced engineers. You'll gain exposure to Azure, SQL, Python, data pipelines, and database operations, receiving mentoring and training to help you grow into a fully-fledged Data Engineer.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who enjoys solving problems, working with data, and learning new technologies.

Your Team

You'll work closely with Data Engineers, Software Engineers, Operations, and Support teams to help deliver reliable, scalable data solutions that support our products and customers.

As part of an Agile engineering environment, you'll collaborate across teams, gain exposure to real-world data challenges, and contribute to the stability and performance of our data platforms while building your technical expertise.

Your Impact

As a Data Engineer, you'll help support and enhance our data platforms by monitoring databases, troubleshooting data issues, and contributing to data validation and deployment activities. Working alongside experienced engineers, you'll build hands-on experience with Azure, SQL, and modern data engineering practices while developing the skills needed to progress your career in data engineering.

Key Skills


SQL and relational database fundamentals
Understanding of data structures and database concepts
Microsoft Azure fundamentals
Basic Python programming
Analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong communication skills
Good organisation and time management
Understanding of Agile ways of working
Ability and enthusiasm to learn new technologies


Desirable


Experience with Azure services such as Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, or Azure Functions
Understanding of data pipelines and orchestration concepts
Exposure to APIs and data integrations
Awareness of DevOps and CI/CD practices
Experience investigating data quality or database issues


Benefits To Support You Personally And Professionally

Alongside the opportunity to work with an incredible team and express your individuality, we offer a range of personalised benefits including:


Access to over 60 internal training courses, professional qualifications, and cross-departmental mentoring and coaching programs
24/7 access to a GP through Help at Hand for you and your family, confidential mental health support, and paid sick leave
Ability to purchase or sell additional holiday days beyond 25 days and bank holidays
Enhanced Family leave
My MHRewards offering discounts at over 900 retailers
Monthly employee recognition program and departmental awards
Referral bonus scheme of up to £2,000
Employee-led social events such as running clubs, football teams, book clubs, and bake-offs
On-site subsidised restaurants offering a variety of fresh meals daily
Opt-in benefits schemes such as private medical insurance and dental coverage


We value the well-being, financial stability, and inclusivity of our employees, and strive to provide a supportive working environment.

At MHR, we’re completely committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where all voices are heard, and everyone feels valued and supported.

Whatever your background, abilities and experiences, if you’re excited by this role we want to hear from you. If you require assistance for an interview, please let us know and we’ll make sure your needs are met when you arrive.

If we receive an exceptionally high volume of applications, we reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier than originally advertised.

Title: Pricing Manager
Description:
Lawfront provides legal services to individuals and businesses through leading regional law firms - Brachers,Farleys, Fisher Jones Greenwood, Field Seymour Parkes, Nelsons, Slater Heelis and Trethowans

The Pricing Manager at Lawfront will be responsible for developing and implementing pricing strategies across the group to maximize profitability and growth. This role involves analysing market trends, competitor pricing, and customer behaviour to set competitive prices for Lawfront's services.

The Pricing Manager will work closely with the Pricing Champion (managing partner of one of our firms), finance, marketing, and regional management to put in place pricing strategies and tactics in line with the company's overall business objectives.

Additionally, the Pricing Manager will support the development of a strong pricing culture within the firms, encouraging confident pricing behaviour among fee earners.

Key Responsibilities


Develop and maintain a group-wide overview of hourly and menu pricing in each firm.
Conduct pricing and profitability analysis and provide recommendations to senior management.
Analyse market trends, competitor pricing, and customer behaviour to set competitive prices.
Monitor and adjust pricing strategies based on market conditions and business needs.
Develop pricing models and tools to support decision-making.
Ensure compliance with pricing policies and regulations.
Organise external pricing training and provide direct support to fee earning teams on pricing strategies and tools.
Encourage strong pricing behaviour among fee earners, mentor, and offer training.
Communicate the benefits of confident pricing and share best practices.
Provide advice on pricing strategy and support management in pricing decisions.


What We Are Looking For?

Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional certification in pricing or related field is a plus.


Skills, Knowledge And Experience


Experience in services pricing, specific exposure to legal services or other professional services environment is a plus.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Experience with pricing software and tools.
Knowledge of market research and data analysis techniques.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Strong organizational and time management skills.


Personal attributes

Changee Agility: Availability, aptitude, and appetite to lead and influence others in line with company messaging.

Adaptability: Displays a pro-active approach and the ability to think on their feet

Self-Awareness: Aware of their impact on others, ability to self-regulate when under pressure and sense of self assurance and confidence, that gives others certainty.

Emotional Intelligence: Demonstrates the ability to support others to be at their best, understands what makes each person unique and adjust style accordingly.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Constantly curious looking for ways to optimise performance, impact, and efficiency. Seeks opportunities to innovate in small and large ways and support this in others.

Trust and Psychological Safety: Creates a culture of high trust where people feel they can speak up without judgment or blame. Each member of the Department feels psychologically safe and able to reach out if support is required.

Apply now or get in touch for a confidential discussion. Contact Suzanne James at Lawfront - Suzanne.james@lawfront.com

Title: PPC & Paid Media Manager
Description:
Job Description

Overview




Would you like to help enrich the lives of learners around the world?




At TTS we aim to give every child, every day, a reason to love learning.




We're proud to have supplied schools and learning environments across the globe with innovative educational resources for 40 years offering over 50,000 resources, of which 6,000 are our own developed IP!




Our in-house experts collaborate with teachers and educational experts to create unique and innovative resources that engage children and inspire a lifelong love of learning. Every TTS resource provides unlimited learning opportunities and is made to last, making the most of schools’ and nurseries’ limited budgets and ensuring years of classroom use.




TTS is part of the RM Group – a pioneer in the education technology space, and since 2004, we share a vision to improve education outcomes worldwide.

At RM, we’ve been pioneers of education technology since 1973. We provide technology and resources to the education sector, supporting over 20 million students and improving educational outcomes worldwide.




What we do helps learners at all stages of their lives, from preschool to higher education and professional qualification; we partner with schools, examination boards, governments, and professional organisations globally to make learning more accessible, more engaging, and more impactful.




RM operates through three divisions: Assessment (digital assessment and marking solutions), Technology (managed services, hardware, and software for schools), and TTS (educational resources).




Visit our website to find out more: https://www.tts-group.co.uk/




The education sector is transforming, so this is an exciting time to join RM as a Digital Performance Manager, working in a hybrid capacity, with two days per week based in Hucknall.




We are seeking an experienced PPC & Paid Media Manager to join TTS and drive the success and growth of our paid online marketing campaigns for our market-leading ecommerce brand in the education sector.




For paid digital advertising you will be responsible for the strategy, execution, and optimisation of paid search campaigns across various online channels. Your focus will be on maximising return on advertising spend, driving customer acquisition, and contributing to the overall revenue growth of the business.




This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about search and has a proven track record of increasing traffic and revenue.




Responsibilities




Job Purpose:




As part of a small and experienced core team, the PPC & Paid Media Manager role is both hands-on and strategic and your day-to-day work will be key to delivering and shaping the future direction and growth of the business.




You will be instrumental in helping to drive and deliver the ambitious paid advertising strategy and revenue targets, in a competitive B2B ecommerce environment.




Working closely with the Senior Digital Acquisition Manager to develop PPC best practice, lead discussions with internal stakeholders, ensure progress and performance is reported regularly. Including:-




Strategy Development: Develop, plan and implement a comprehensive digital advertising strategy tailored to the company’s objectives of driving traffic and generating revenue.




Campaign Management: Manage the day-to-day operations of paid campaigns, including budget allocation, bid management and ad copy creative optimisation




Data Driven: Utilise all available data to seek out gaps and new opportunities and formulate this into an executable strategy




Keyword Research: Perform keyword research and content gap analysis to identify and optimise content and monitor the performance of keywords to maximise ROI.

Management Reporting: Develop and present detailed reports on campaign performance, including ROAS, conversions, revenue and other KPIs to stakeholders.




A/B Testing: Conduct A/B testing on various campaign elements to identify the best-performing paid strategies.




Technical SEO & Audits: Conduct audits and monitor website performance and resolve any issues that affect search performance using tools such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs and SEM Rush. This includes optimising site structure, improving page speed, and monitoring Core Web Vitals.




Content Optimisation: Work closely with the content, brand and product teams to ensure that content is optimised for search engines and addresses the needs of our target audience.




Outreach Campaign Management: Develop and execute effective outreach and link building strategies to build effective backlink strategies and enhance domain authority and rankings.




Analytics and Reporting: Monitor and analyse daily performance metrics with tools such as GA4 and GSC to understand performance and recognise when action is required. Provide regular updates to senior management.




Insights & Trends: Analyse website data and also the paid search data to identify insights and keyword trends to achieve first-page search engine rankings




Market and Competitor Analysis: Analyse competitor campaigns and market trends to identify opportunities and insights.

Stay Informed: Keep up to date with the latest industry news, trends, best practices, search engine algorithms, and sharing knowledge with the team




Experience




Experience in digital performance management (agency or in-house), preferably in a large e-commerce store environment.
Solid understanding of the core aspects of digital performance
Solid understanding of the core aspects of PPC and managing data feeds for Google Shopping
Proficient in the use of Google Ads, Bing Ads, Google Analytics, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Search Console, Merchant Centre, Ahrefs, Excel and other data tools
Exceptional analytical skills, with a solid understanding of web metrics and digital analytics with the ability to analyse data and provide actionable insights
Analytically minded and proficient in the use of Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and other tools.
Solid technical acumen, displaying working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Experience managing a team, their workflow and assisting in their own professional development.
Ability to define structured plans, clear communication and foster collaboration to ensure timely delivery of work within an ambiguous, fast paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness to engage in the ways of working in a large, trading-focused business with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional and international team structure

What’s in it for you?




As well as a competitive salary and our core benefits package which includes private medical healthcare, life assurance and a Group Personal Pension Plan with higher contribution levels available, some roles are also eligible for a performance-related bonus. There are lots of voluntary benefits too. You could buy additional annual leave, join our dental plan, sign up for a health assessment, or take part in our cycle to work scheme. You could even earn yourself an extra bonus for successfully recommending a friend or family member for a position within RM.




To better reflect the society that we serve, we’re committed to building a diverse workforce and creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all. To achieve this, we create teams of talented people from different backgrounds and experiences and strive to be a business where our people can bring their whole selves to work. We also want to make the recruitment process as inclusive as possible for everyone. Should you require additional support with your application or through the interview process, please contact us at recruitment@rm.com.




Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Title: Management Accountant (4289)
Description:
Management Accountant – FTC

Location: Hucknall

Salary: £40,000 - £50,000

Contract: Fixed-Term Contract - 15 months. Hybrid working.




About the Client

Our client is a well-established Education organisation with a collaborative finance function and a strong focus on supporting its wider business objectives. They cultivate a supportive atmosphere where professional development is valued, with teams working together across different functions to deliver high-quality outcomes.




About the Job

This fixed-term Management Accountant position will provide key support to the finance team, combining month-end and management reporting responsibilities with analysis, audit support and involvement in business improvement projects. The role offers plenty of interaction across finance and the wider organisation, including working with an overseas transactional reporting team.




Duties will include:

Assisting with month-end reporting and the production of management information, including divisional reporting for Group purposes.
Completing and reviewing balance sheet and accounting reconciliations to maintain accurate financial records.
Collaborating with wider finance teams and the transactional reporting function in India to ensure financial information is complete and accurate.
Contributing to finance transformation projects, including process improvements and changes to accounting systems.
Supporting the Group audit process and working with external auditors to provide information and investigate queries.
Producing ad-hoc financial analysis and commercial insight to support business requirements.
Helping to identify opportunities to strengthen processes and improve financial documentation.




About the Successful Applicant




You will have previous Management Accounting or Finance Business Partnering experience and ideally be ACA, ACCA or CIMA part-qualified, or possess equivalent experience. Strong Excel, general ledger accounting, financial systems, reporting and analytical skills are important. You will be comfortable working cross-functionally, able to interpret the story behind the numbers and communicate financial information clearly, with excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.




What You Will Receive in Return

This is an opportunity to join a collaborative Education organisation and play an active role within its finance function. You will gain exposure to management reporting, audit, cross-functional working and finance transformation, while contributing to projects focused on improving processes and systems. The position should particularly appeal to someone who enjoys solving problems and is motivated by working within the education sector.

Job Summary

Join HM Land Registry and help us deliver one of the UK's most significant digital transformation programmes.

As a Data Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting the migration of Local Land Charges data from local authorities into HM Land Registry's digital Local Land Charges Register. Working as part of a supportive national team, you will help transform paper-based records into accurate digital information, ensuring high-quality data is available for customers across England and Wales.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, has a keen eye for detail, and is looking to develop their administrative and digital skills while contributing to a programme of national importance.

Job Description

The Local Land Charges Register was launched by HM Land Registry to modernise and centralise Local Land Charges information. To support the migration of data from local authorities onto the digital register, we work collaboratively with local authority partners to access, extract, capture and improve data quality.

As a Data Administrator, you will work in both HM Land Registry offices and local authority settings, carrying out a range of administrative and data-focused activities. You will help scan and digitise records, input and validate data, support the creation of spatial information and work alongside local authority colleagues to help resolve data issues.

This role may include regular travel across England and Wales. You should be comfortable travelling nationally and, on occasion, staying away from home during the working week.

Main Duties

As a Data Administrator, You Will:


Provide administrative support to Local Authority Delivery Managers and colleagues across the Local Land Charges Programme.
Bulk scan local authority paper records in line with established procedures and quality standards.
Input Local Land Charges information from scanned images to create accurate digital records.
Support the creation and maintenance of spatial data linked to Local Land Charges records.
Work closely with local authority colleagues to identify and resolve data quality issues.
Identify, investigate and escalate complex data issues to relevant programme teams.
Liaise, under supervision, with suppliers and stakeholders to help coordinate solutions to data-related issues.
Travel to local authority offices to undertake scanning, data input and data cleansing activities.
Ensure data is handled accurately, securely and in accordance with agreed processes.
Contribute to the successful delivery of programme objectives through effective teamwork and collaboration.


What We Offer

In return, we offer:


The opportunity to contribute to a nationally important digital transformation programme.
Full training to help you develop a strong understanding of Local Land Charges and the work of HM Land Registry.
A supportive and inclusive working environment where everyone is encouraged to succeed.
The chance to work with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, developing valuable professional skills and experience.
Ongoing learning and development opportunities to support your career growth.
The opportunity to be part of an enthusiastic, collaborative and purpose-driven national team.
Excellent support from experienced colleagues across the organisation.
Access to the Civil Service Pension Scheme and a comprehensive employee benefits package.
Flexible working opportunities where business needs allow.

As a Python Developer, you will create and enhance software that underpins secure information services used in demanding, highly controlled environments.

Availability to work from the Nottingham site one to two days each week.




Other
